programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Misguided inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that can turn water into food. But what initially seems like the answer to his community's economic crisis soon begins to cause some unexpected problems.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy with the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Flint Lockwood's mutating machine is no longer turning water into food but producing food/animal hybrids, or foodimals, which very quickly overrun his home town.

programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, Chris Rock and David Schwimmer. A zebra called Marty tries to escape his comfortable existence at the Central Park Zoo and return to the wild. Accompanying him, albeit reluctantly, are Alex the lion, a neurotic giraffe and a no-nonsense hippo.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, David Schwimmer and Chris Rock. The escaped animals from Central Park Zoo - Alex the Lion, Melman the Giraffe, Marty the Zebra and Gloria the Hippo - try to fly back from Madagascar but are forced down in the wilds of Africa, where they soon encounter some familiar faces.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: Horror comedy based on the popular books by R L Stine, starring Jack Black. When 15-year-old Zach breaks into his neighbour's house to investigate strange noises, he discovers that he lives next door to the author of the Goosebumps series, whose monstrous creations have to be kept in locked manuscripts. But when the monsters get loose, it's up to Zach to help imprison them again.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical based on the Broadway hit, starring Quvenzhané Wallis, Cameron Diaz and Jamie Foxx. A foster child's life changes after accidentally meeting a workaholic tycoon running for mayor of New York.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: Second World War action adventure directed by Quentin Tarantino and starring Brad Pitt. After a Jewish woman's family are slaughtered by the Nazis, she changes her identity and flees to Paris, only to come face to face with the man responsible for the massacre. Meanwhile, Lt Aldo Raine leads a guerrilla squad of Jewish Americans into occupied territory to carry out a series of raids on the enemy, earning a fearsome reputation in the process.

programme.title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Geena Davis and Samuel L Jackson. A housewife with amnesia who hires a private detective to find out about her past life discovers that she was once a hitwoman for the CIA, and that someone wants her dead.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jason Statham. A troubled former soldier on the run from a court martial assumes another man's identity and goes into hiding on the streets of London. But the desire to avenge injustice is something he can never leave behind.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Jet Li. A highly skilled group of mercenaries are commissioned by a shady operative to assassinate the murderous dictator of a South American island. But they should know that an operation like this is never straightforward.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Bruce Willis. The crack team of mercenaries take on what looks like the easy job of retrieving an item from a crashed plane in Albania. But when one of the group is murdered by an international arms dealer, it turns into a mission of revenge.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: Black comedy action horror starring Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino and Juliette Lewis. Fleeing the law, two murderous brothers kidnap a priest and his family, driving the priest's Winnebago south for a rendezvous at a lowlife bar in Mexico. Little do they know that the bar's staff and regulars hide a blood-drenched secret.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and Ricardo Montalban. In the 23rd century, Admiral James T Kirk is a guest aboard the Enterprise, which is taking part in a training exercise. But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman and Chris O'Donnell. Former district attorney Harvey Two-Face holds Batman responsible for the attack that left half of his face disfigured, while brilliant scientist Edward Nygma bears a grudge against Batman's alter ego, Bruce Wayne, for rejecting one of his experiments. The pair decide to combine forces to exact their revenge.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: National Security
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Steve Zahn. A string of misunderstandings lead to by-the-book cop Hank Rafferty being dismissed from the force and serving a prison sentence for an apparent racial attack on police cadet Earl Montgomery. On his release, Hank is forced to take a job as a lowly security guard, where he is thrown together with an unexpected partner.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: Historical satire starring Steve Buscemi and Simon Russell Beale. In the immediate aftermath of Joseph Stalin's death in 1953, his cabinet jockey for position in the hope of becoming the next Soviet leader. As they argue over everything from funeral arrangements to the fate of the dictator's offspring, the divided government struggles to maintain order.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: Comedy that reunites the gang from the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan and Seann William Scott. Old friends Jim, Oz and Stifler assemble for their high school reunion, but while they might now be thirty-somethings with all the trappings of a suburban lifestyle, trouble, and rampant hormones, are still not far away.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Risqué teen comedy starring Tom Cruise and Rebecca De Mornay. Left to safeguard the family home while his parents are away, promising student Joel Goodson seizes the chance to have the time of his life. But when a friend's prank results in Joel being visited by troubled prostitute Lana, things get out of hand.

programme.title: King Ivory
programme.desc: Tulsa narcotics cop Layne West is locked in a battle with the city's criminal underworld. When his son becomes addicted to fentanyl, West teams up with his partner Ty and FBI agent Beatty to bring down those responsible. Thriller, starring James Badge Dale and Ben Foster

programme.title: One Last Deal
programme.desc: A veteran sports agent scrambles to land one last high-stakes deal for his star client, with both their futures on the line. Drama, starring Danny Dyer and Elliott Rogers

programme.title: Mulholland Drive
programme.desc: Psychological thriller directed by David Lynch, starring Naomi Watts, Laura Elena Harring and Justin Theroux. An aspiring actress lands in Hollywood and is quickly drawn into the mystery of an amnesiac woman who has arrived at her lodgings. Meanwhile, a director battles sinister forces to try to complete his latest film.

programme.title: Lurker
programme.desc: A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death. Writer/director Alex Russell's crime drama, starring Théodore Pellerin, Archie Madekwe and Sunny Suljic

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Mulholland Drive
programme.desc: Psychological thriller directed by David Lynch, starring Naomi Watts, Laura Elena Harring and Justin Theroux. An aspiring actress lands in Hollywood and is quickly drawn into the mystery of an amnesiac woman who has arrived at her lodgings. Meanwhile, a director battles sinister forces to try to complete his latest film.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Musical comedy drama starring Kenny Wormald, Julianne Hough and Dennis Quaid. When a small town bans all unsupervised dancing, it's up to a rebel city boy to shake things loose.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Prison drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman. Maine 1946: sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife and her lover, mild-mannered banker Andy Dufresne tries to adapt to the brutalities of prison life. Over the years, Dufresne's friendship with long-term inmate Red and the discovery that his financial expertise is suddenly in big demand make his ordeal easier to bear.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: Failed actress Lucy Mason is a star employee of the Adore matchmaking agency. She prefers the life of a singleton after her previous relationship with actor John imploded because of his precarious finances. At a client's wedding, Lucy meets the groom's brother, Harry, and politely rebuffs his amorous advances, suggesting he should enrol with Adore. Harry persists and Lucy agrees to go on a date, on condition that he signs up with the agency after their lunchtime liaison. Writer/director Celine Song's romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Chris Evans and Pedro Pascal

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Prison drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman. Maine 1946: sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife and her lover, mild-mannered banker Andy Dufresne tries to adapt to the brutalities of prison life. Over the years, Dufresne's friendship with long-term inmate Red and the discovery that his financial expertise is suddenly in big demand make his ordeal easier to bear.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring David Duchovny and Julianne Moore. When scientists Ira Kane and Harry Block find a crashed meteorite in the Arizona desert, they are able to extract a slimy blue fluid from it. But the bizarre substance contains alien organisms that are capable of evolving at an unprecedented rate, and this has consequences for the survival of Earth itself.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Horror remake starring Jane Levy, Shiloh Fernandez and Lou Taylor Pucci. Four friends decamp to an isolated cabin in the woods to help drug addict Mia kick her habit. However, when one of them quotes from an ancient book of the dead, the forces of hell are unleashed and no one is safe.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring David Duchovny and Julianne Moore. When scientists Ira Kane and Harry Block find a crashed meteorite in the Arizona desert, they are able to extract a slimy blue fluid from it. But the bizarre substance contains alien organisms that are capable of evolving at an unprecedented rate, and this has consequences for the survival of Earth itself.

programme.title: Brightburn
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Elizabeth Banks, David Denman and Jackson A Dunn. A Kansas couple discovers a humanoid alien child inside a crashed spaceship and adopt him. Years later, the boy reaches adolescence - and starts to develop powers that pose a major threat to his community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Chris Pine and Zachary Quinto. Rebellious youth James Kirk is persuaded to join the Starfleet Academy, where he befriends Dr Leonard "Bones" McCoy and clashes with officer Spock. When an evil Romulan arrives from the future, the young crew of the USS Enterprise find themselves in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Frances McDormand, Woody Harrelson and Sam Rockwell. Seven months after Mildred Hayes's daughter was found raped and murdered, no suspect has come to light. A frustrated Mildred erects three signs publicly accusing the police chief of incompetence, which only turns the town against her.

programme.title: Nomadland
programme.desc: Road movie starring Frances McDormand. Following the death of her husband and the loss of her job, a sixty-something Nevadan sells her belongings and buys a van, which she uses to travel the States while working odd jobs. Along the way, she meets a number of fellow travellers and starts to embrace America's "nomad" communities.

programme.title: Destination Gobi
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Richard Widmark. When their weather station is attacked by the Japanese, an American naval contingent embarks on a gruelling, 800-mile journey across the Gobi Desert.

programme.title: This Gun for Hire
programme.desc: A hired assassin sets out to find the man who paid him with money the police are tracking. He finds an unlikely ally in the girlfriend of one of the detectives on his trail. Thriller based on a novel by Graham Greene, starring Alan Ladd, Veronica Lake, Robert Preston and Laird Cregar

programme.title: The Comancheros
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne. Texas Ranger Jake Cutter finds an unlikely ally in a tough gambler as he sets out on the trail of a gang of ruthless outlaws who are supplying arms and liquor to the Comanches.

programme.title: Earth vs the Flying Saucers
programme.desc: Science-fiction fantasy starring Hugh Marlowe. After aliens abduct his father-in-law, a research scientist tries to prevent an invasion of the Earth.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Halle Berry and Patrick Wilson. When the Moon's orbit starts to change, Earth is threatened with imminent destruction. Two former astronauts and an amateur lunar researcher blast off to try to save the day - but the source of this astronomic anomaly is much tougher to fight than they realise.

programme.title: I.S.S
programme.desc: Aboard the International Space Station, tensions flare between the US and Russian astronauts after a nuclear war breaks out on Earth. Sci-fi space thriller, starring Ariana DeBose, Chris Messina and John Gallagher Jr.

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Idris Elba. Grieving widower Dr Nate Samuels takes his two daughters to a South African game reserve, hoping that the trip will be a healing experience for them. But when the family crosses paths with a huge, rogue lion, Nate realises that the predator will stop at nothing to claim its prey.

programme.title: Momentum
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Olga Kurylenko and James Purefoy. A glamorous jewel thief goes on the run from a master assassin when her face is accidentally revealed in the middle of a heist.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: Spaghetti western starring James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer. A disgraced Union colonel assembles a motley crew of condemned men to retake the fort that he surrendered to the Confederates.

programme.title: The Pledge
programme.desc: A vengeful sheriff tracks down the escaped killer who murdered his family, but in the ensuing confrontation he accidentally shoots an innocent bystander. programme.desc:
We follow Alicia and her family as they learn about and observe Remembrance Day. They start with a walk, where they count all the poppies that have been put around their village - how many will there be? Later, they visit a camp where they learn what it was like to live in the UK during World War II. An air raid siren goes off, and they practice running into an old Anderson shelter!
The family then visits an air museum, where Alicia is shown lots of amazing aircraft from the war. Alicia finds out what it was like to fly them when she meets a 99-year-old World War II pilot John. They go flying together and have a fantastic time! John then shows her his medals and tells her his amazing stories of being a pilot in the war.
Before heading home, Alicia and her family pay their respects to those who have served in the line of duty by laying a wreath at the Armed Forces Memorial in the National Memorial Arboretum. They remember everyone who has served to protect us whilst a bugler plays The Last Post.

programme.title: Losgannan/Froglets
programme.desc:
Le cuideachadh bho Burtaidh, tha Sif a' toirt Pipp agus Bran air dàn-chuairt fèill spòrs.
Ziff leads Pipp and Button on a fairground adventure with help from faithful Bertie.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Baby Soup Dragon is unhappy as he isn't allowed to play with the soup spoon as it's too big for him. Fortunately, Small suggests that he can help them with delivering the soup instead - and he is hugely helpful

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Tha bogsa dìomhaireachd air laighe air a' phlanaid, le rudan annasach na bhroinn - clobhdan a tha nan tuill cuideachd. Tha e comasach dha na Clangairean siubhal tro na tuill seo - agus abair gu bheil iad trang a' siubhal!
A mysterious box has landed on the planet, with curious things inside it - cloths which are also holes. The Clangers can travel through these holes, and they do it a lot!

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Petit and his friends are having a lot of fun pretending to be robots, until one of them presses a button and Petit gets the hiccups. Why can't he stop hiccupping? Greg can't stop sneezing, Laura yawns and Roman coughs. Could it be that everyone is turning into real-life robots?

programme.title: 'S E Iasg a Th'Annam (I'm a Fish)
programme.desc: The sheephead fish, which is very sneaky - it can eat pretty much anything as it has very sharp teeth and can steal the bait off fishing hooks without getting caught

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Morag Ann MacNeil reads A' Choinean Chòir by Katie Cotton, illustrated by Blanca Gomez and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart

programme.title: Bethany - An Dannsair Gàidhealach (Bethany - The Highland Dancer)
programme.desc: Born into a family of Highland dancers, 11-year-old Bethany is determined to follow in the footsteps of her mum and aunties. Highland dancing is more than just an artform and requires strength and determination. The sword dance, an ancient dance of war, was once danced by warriors before battle and was considered a good omen if the dance was completed without touching the swords. Bethany sets herself a daunting challenge - performing the notoriously difficult dance, at a major Highland dancing competition in Stornoway

programme.title: Belle agus Sebastian
programme.desc: Sebastian is so happy when he gets Caspar's old mountain journal - a very special book. Unfortunately though, Mr Turner confiscates it, as a punishment. How can he tell Caspar about this?

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Choirstaidh takes a look at the famous artist Hilma Af Klint, and shows you how to make your own picture in her style

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc: Bitzer gets his wish for some peace and quiet when Shaun becomes hypnotised by Mowermouth the goat and finally stops bothering him. However, with the whole flock under the influence of Mowermouth's powerful gaze, Bitzer soon realises just how much he needs his old friend

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: A Great Dane called Greta visits Flix's school as a part of official Dog/Cat Summit Relations. Flix positions himself as Greta's chaperone for the week

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: The lads contemplate winter and come up with heart-warming comfort foods. Ruairidh cooks red cabbage and a lamb hotpot with mint sauce, and Uisdean prepares a mutton chump roast

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon walks along the south end of Kerrera with Kim Carnie, a few miles away from where she was raised in Oban. As they walk along picturesque bays with panoramic views of Oban Bay and the Slate Islands, Kim discusses the importance of Gaelic in her life and how that has shaped her life and career as a singer. She opens up about love and identity and how that has evolved over the years while enjoying the surrounding nature and fresh autumn air

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon goes on a journey to find out about the deep divide between wealth and poverty in São Paulo, Brazil. From the affluent gated communities to the overcrowded favelas, invisible walls separate people in this city. On his journey, Ramsay hears from individuals who are determined to break down division by creating opportunities for people within some of the city's most disadvantaged communities

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Award-winning musician Calum McIlroy and band, recorded at the 2024 Trad Awards. The set includes Strathspeys & Reel, The Banks of Newfoundland agus Polonessa Spoof

programme.title: Dàna - Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Shetland's expansive coastline is home to endless towering cliffs, but its remoteness from the mainland means they see few ascents. With a good friend in tow, Coinneach Rankin travels to Shetland in search of new routes and spectacular climbing challenges

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame (Rebuilding Notre-Dame)
programme.desc: As part of the restoration, researchers turn their attention to recovering the cathedral's acoustics, as well as the light and colours that created its beauty. A dense layer of soot is removed from the stained glass. Meanwhile, the stone - now exposed - reveals its true colors - proving that the cathedral was fully painted. The hope is that the world's most famous organ will once again resound within Notre-Dame's walls

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After a hair-raising drive across the Conor Pass and a spot of seaside silliness hitting golf balls into the ocean, Bill Murray bids farewell to Chris O'Dowd. In County Clare, Bill and his friend Tom Coyne's attempt to sneak unnoticed into a hurling match goes awry, before an emotional reunion recalls an unforgettable act of kindness. Then, a chance invitation in Ballybunion leads to a freezing Atlantic challenge

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti launch the search the next culinary star with a series of demanding challenges designed to test their skills to the limit. The first six chefs to enter the kitchen begin by taking on a skills test in which they pair up to recreate a crab raviolo dish, served with a rich, deeply flavoured bisque. Then they serve up a signature dish - knowing one of them will soon be hanging up their apron

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Documentary charting the rise of three of Britain's most influential culinary figures, Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal. This first helping explores how Marco challenged French-dominated kitchens in the 1980s, transforming British gastronomy, setting standards for Gordon and Heston. Contributors include Marcus Wareing, Michel Roux Jr, Angela Hartnett, Clare Smyth and Tom Kerridge

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Friends Aimi and Neil on the red team and siblings Joe and Bella in blue scour an antiques centre in Taunton, Somerset for bargains to sell for profit under the guidance of Ben Cooper and Danny Sebastian. Christina Trevanion visits the historic town of Malmesbury in neighbouring Wiltshire

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin Roberts is impressed by the use of space at a West Midlands terrace. Dion Dublin is in Salford, where less might be more with a project, while the opposite is true with three flats on offer in Croydon, as visited by Jacqui Joseph

programme.title: The Reluctant Vampire
programme.desc: The day of Val's initiation ceremony approaches, and he still has no idea how he'll pass the vampire test. When his final plan doesn't work out, he realises he can no longer live a double life and is faced with the ultimate dilemma. Should he come clean and risk everything for the chance of a human life or sacrifice who he really is for the sake of his family?

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts another first-round match as family trio the Creepy Crawleys take on former work colleagues the Risk Takers. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects Kite's Nest, Ravenseat, Duchy Home, and Diddly Squat.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Epic Second World War drama starring John Mills, Bernard Lee and Richard Attenborough. In 1940, more than 338,000 retreating Allied troops were evacuated from the beaches around Dunkirk. This film re-creates the daring operation from the perspective of the soldiers who were there as well as the men who set sail from England to rescue them.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents the show from Dartington Hall in Devon, where the treasures on display include a set of royal cufflinks and a letter from Lord Nelson. Plus, the story of a valuable collection of silver, which astonished parishioners when it was discovered at the back of a safe in a village church

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: At Huddersfield Town Hall, West Yorkshire, Nick Davies is drawn to a bobbin holder that reveals the town's textile heritage, while Christina Trevanion finds an incredible collection of glass scent bottles. Presenter Paul Martin delves into the area's coal mining history

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Dame Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor presents a first look at how some of the celebrities are getting on with their next dances. Also, Strictly judges Shirley Ballas and Anton Du Beke drop in for a chat

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul head to Shetland to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful archipelago for trout and pollock. The archipelago of about 100 islands off the north-east coast of Scotland is the furthest place in the UK they have travelled to fish, and it is wild and full of surprises for both of them

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Through interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah looks at the international quantum arms race between the US and China

programme.title: Air Fryer: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah Fry explores the story of the kitchen device, going behind the scenes with air fryer originators Philips. She also discovers how the accidental creation of a wonder wire in the 1900s, a First World War pilot's cold dinner and one man tinkering in his garage brought about this modern marvel that's redefining cooking

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Textile conservator Rebecca Bissonnet faces the challenge of restoring a Manchester United football shirt worn by a Busby Babe in the 1958 FA Cup final, while bookbinder Chris Shaw works delicately to preserve the battered pages and weathered covers of a Bible from a wartime internment camp. Munwar Hussain arrives with a beautiful but damaged Punjabi hookah once belonging to his grandfather, and brother and sister David and Lee from Huddersfield present an extraordinary automaton - a miniature watchmaker at work in his shop

programme.title: Murder in Belfast - Sisters Seeking Justice
programme.desc: The final part of the investigation into Robert McCartney's murder. Police believe they are closer to catching Robert's killers, but have to contend with the fact that some witnesses have also been talking to the IRA. As the political ramifications of the murder settle, a trial finally looms and Robert's family hope that their years of battling have put justice in reach

programme.title: Rewind: 60 Years of Welsh Pop - Cardiff
programme.desc: The Welsh capital has always had a rich and varied music scene. From the Queen of Tiger Bay herself - Shirley Bassey - to Dave Edmunds, Shakin' Stevens and Charlotte Church, this episode shines a light on some of the artists who have helped place Cardiff firmly on the music map

Hidden from the world by his guardian Claude Frollo, the Minister for Justice, he is taken pity on by a gypsy girl called Esmeralda.

programme.desc: Rachel Allen showcases festive recipes that will impress Christmas guests. She creates a fun gingerbread house and teaches her students how to make perfect mince pies.

programme.title: James Martin and Christmas Friends
programme.desc: James Martin invites some of his celebrity friends round for a festive feast. He's joined by actor Jimi Mistry and chef Paul Ainsworth gives his take on a Christmas lunch.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's 12 Tastes of Christmas
programme.desc: Nigel Slater shares his favourite festive dishes, from tempting treats to a feast on the big day. And, in Norway he sees how Scandinavian flavours capture the essence of Christmas.

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Frances McDormand, Woody Harrelson and Sam Rockwell. Seven months after Mildred Hayes's daughter was found raped and murdered, no suspect has come to light. A frustrated Mildred erects three signs publicly accusing the police chief of incompetence, which only turns the town against her.

programme.title: Nomadland
programme.desc: Road movie starring Frances McDormand. Following the death of her husband and the loss of her job, a sixty-something Nevadan sells her belongings and buys a van, which she uses to travel the States while working odd jobs. Along the way, she meets a number of fellow travellers and starts to embrace America's "nomad" communities.

programme.title: Destination Gobi
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Richard Widmark. When their weather station is attacked by the Japanese, an American naval contingent embarks on a gruelling, 800-mile journey across the Gobi Desert.

programme.title: This Gun for Hire
programme.desc: A hired assassin sets out to find the man who paid him with money the police are tracking. He finds an unlikely ally in the girlfriend of one of the detectives on his trail. Thriller based on a novel by Graham Greene, starring Alan Ladd, Veronica Lake, Robert Preston and Laird Cregar

programme.title: The Comancheros
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne. Texas Ranger Jake Cutter finds an unlikely ally in a tough gambler as he sets out on the trail of a gang of ruthless outlaws who are supplying arms and liquor to the Comanches.

programme.title: Earth vs the Flying Saucers
programme.desc: Science-fiction fantasy starring Hugh Marlowe. After aliens abduct his father-in-law, a research scientist tries to prevent an invasion of the Earth.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Halle Berry and Patrick Wilson. When the Moon's orbit starts to change, Earth is threatened with imminent destruction. Two former astronauts and an amateur lunar researcher blast off to try to save the day - but the source of this astronomic anomaly is much tougher to fight than they realise.

programme.title: I.S.S
programme.desc: Aboard the International Space Station, tensions flare between the US and Russian astronauts after a nuclear war breaks out on Earth. Sci-fi space thriller, starring Ariana DeBose, Chris Messina and John Gallagher Jr.

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Idris Elba. Grieving widower Dr Nate Samuels takes his two daughters to a South African game reserve, hoping that the trip will be a healing experience for them. But when the family crosses paths with a huge, rogue lion, Nate realises that the predator will stop at nothing to claim its prey.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Stringed instrument restorer Julyan Wallis sets to work on a beloved banjo. The banjo belonged to Kipper Tranter's dear departed friend, Ted. Many years ago, Ted took a young and wayward Kipper under his wing, for which Kipper is eternally grateful. The friends shared a love of bluegrass music and would regularly play together. When Ted passed away, he wanted his beloved banjo to go to Kipper. The 80-year-old instrument is not in great shape and Kipper would love it repaired, so that it can be passed onto another generation of musical talent.
The workshop's next arrival is Julia Emmett from Berkshire, with a pair of vintage rollerskates for leather gal Suzie Fletcher. The 1930s skates belonged to her father, who was quite something back in the day, whizzing around on this set of wheels. They are a treasured memento for Julia but the leather is parched and cracked and the wooden wheels are riddled with holes, courtesy of some hungry woodworm.
And antique restorer Will Kirk's expertise is called upon when David Worssom arrives with a very old and elaborate wooden salad bowl. This unusual item was presented to David's grandfather in the late 1800s during his service in the Boer War. The bowl was then inherited by his father and was a familiar fixture in David's family home. It conjures vivid memories of his father and his childhood. The various segments of the bowl are falling apart, the only thing holding it together is some ornate silver fretwork. Brenton West tends to the silver while Will reassembles the puzzle.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: The celebratory launch of a new luxury resort is cut short when a woman is found electrocuted in her hotel bathtub - with the door locked from the inside. It looks like a simple case of suicide, but with Jack Mooney no longer around to confirm Commissioner Selwyn's suspicions, DI Neville Parker is temporarily flown over from Manchester to close the case. However, he soon realises that island life is not for him, so when evidence of suspicious activity turns up, he is dismayed to realise he will have to extend his stay and investigate the case as murder. Ralf Little joins the cast, with guest appearances by Steve Pemberton and Samantha Bond

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A desert island survival course goes wrong when the leader - a trained survival expert and ex-SAS soldier - is found dead in the forest of a remote island near Saint Marie. Having ventured off into the wilderness alone and with no other people on the island apart from the trip participants, suspicion soon falls upon them. But with all of the course members providing one another with an alibi, how could any of them have committed the murder? That's what new detective inspector Neville intends to find out. Starring Ralf Little

programme.desc: A wanted fugitive tries to escape as officers take her fingerprints, and a doctor entering America is caught smuggling in prescription medication worth thousands of dollars.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef visits the home of New Nordic cuisine - Copenhagen - where he goes foraging for rosehip and learns about the art of pickling buds, bark and flowers. He's cheered to find plenty of traditional favourites, such as the city's famous Smorrebrod open sandwiches on rye bread, delicious poached turbot with cabbage and lemon butter sauce and - of course - the ubiquitous Danish pastry. Back at home, Rick cooks fried pork belly with lovage potatoes and parsley sauce, which has been voted Denmark's favourite dish

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef heads to Cadiz in Spain, where he samples two of the city's most revered culinary stars - fresh tuna and Manzanilla sherry. Rick is captivated by the narrow winding streets as he walks in the footsteps of the ancient Phoenician and Arab traders, whose influence on the city can still be seen to this day. Back home, he prepares flamenco eggs and arroz verde, or green rice, made with garlic, parsley, clams and prawns, producing the vibrant colours of the Spanish flag

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers explore the history of the Vegetarian Society and discover how the movement changed public attitudes and became part of the mainstream. They also consider how British gardening has influenced the nation's cuisine, and provide a few recipes along the way

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales go in search of the lost route between London and the sea, which has not been fully open for more than 200 years and requires four different boats to traverse now. They leave the Thames at Teddington and travel through the Surrey and Sussex countryside before arriving at Guildford, and a canal-side theatre where they have both regularly performed. The final leg of the trip brings them to the River Arun before reaching the English Channel

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Richard Hammond and James May try mini-cabbing and take the Renault Scenic and the Ford C-Max out for a spin. Jeremy Clarkson gets behind the wheel of the Spyker C8 Spyder, and Lionel Richie puts his motoring skills to the test as the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car

programme.title: How Britain Worked
programme.desc: Guy Martin works on a machine that can be credited with helping to kick-start the Industrial Revolution. Joining a team from the Black Country Living Museum, he helps to restore a Newcomen engine - an 18th-century steam-powered device used principally to pump water out of mines. As the rotting timber structure is replaced, worn parts repaired, the boiler cleaned and crumbling brickwork rebuilt, the presenter also learns about the lives of the men, women and children who mined coal

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe, Colin Lane and Jimmy Carr join regular panellist Alan Davies and host Sandi Toksvig for an extended edition of the comedy panel quiz show. During the course of the show, the panellists find out how to sort the sheep from the goats, discover the opposite of Tarzan, and meet the telescope that points straight through the Earth. programme.title: Bargain Hunt

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers gets nostalgic over an ice cream cart turned business opportunity, the dealers are serenaded by one hopeful seller, and an antique screen prompts a fierce bidding war

Game show in which 24 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted

programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Gregson, Anthony Quayle and Peter Finch. Ten days before the start of the Second World War, Germany's crack pocket battleship, the Graf Spee, is awaiting instructions in the South Atlantic to commence hostilities; its brief is to attack British cargo vessels. It soon becomes clear that the British Navy has its work cut out to destroy the craft.

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents as the experts set out their stalls at the Beamish Open Air Museum in Co Durham. Among the items presented for their scrutiny are a music box valued at £20,000 and a rare rapier - believed to have been smuggled out of Russia in the props box of the Bolshoi Ballet. Plus, a collector of battlefield objects discusses his hobby. Originally shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team value antiques at the historic Oxford Union. Christina Trevanion picks out a famous fake, and Mark Stacey examines a rare Baptist bust. Meanwhile, Paul looks into the history of the auction site, which is built on top of Greenham Common

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: The penultimate round of challenges for Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson. Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor chats to more couples about their weekend preparations. Plus, costume designer Vicky Gill reveals some of her newest creations

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin explore why geese fly in a V formation, why leaves change colour in autumn and why birds eat rocks

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Humanity's water supplies are shrinking amid climate change, population growth and poor management. Scarcity is displacing millions and could fuel conflicts. Hannah travels to Kenya to witness the crisis, and explores technologies offering ways to protect supplies and meet demand

programme.title: Fridge: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah Fry takes a look at the fridge, hitting the production lines with appliance giants Bosch to find the life-blood at the heart of every single one of these cooling devices. She also explores the fridge's history, revealing how a French monk with a flair for chemistry, a 17th-century chicken incubator and an explosive invention in Australia created the ultimate chill

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: The presenter explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of capital's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored plot close to where he grew up in Hampshire, and some gardens known for their different and personal styles of planting

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Marco Pierre White chases Michelin stars, Gordon Ramsay breaks away to build his own name, and Heston Blumenthal rewrites the rules as success brings fame and new pressures. Gordon recounts the story of the stealing of his restaurant's reservation book, revealing just how bitter the situation became, while Marcus Wareing, Gordon's first employee, recalls the early days of Gordon's kitchen and the fierce ambition driving it

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk meets Hollywood legends and interrogates the writer of Die Hard as she starts her quest deep into cinema. Along the way she interviews film-makers, actors and critics, and finally discovers the true meaning of The Wizard of Oz. Diane Morgan stars

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events

They target branches of the Texas Midlands Bank, an institution that is threatening to foreclose on their family farm. However, the predictable nature of the thefts allows a veteran ranger to second-guess their moves.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.title: Social Media Monsters
programme.desc: Serious crimes where social media played a significant role. Shortly after 15-year-old Elianne Andam's friend broke up with 17-year-old Hassan Sentamu, a meeting between the ex-partners ended in humiliation for Hassan, prompting him to tell his friends online that 'he can't let it slide'. The next time he saw the girls, he was carrying a knife

Then comes the most extravagant temptation yet - the chance to stay at an opulent mansion, complete with fine dining and every comfort they've been denied since the trek began. Finally, they make it to the end of the trek - where one last temptation awaits. Only then do they find out how much their journey has really cost

programme.title: Grand Designs

Justin's vision is to restore the lodge but demolish the ugly toilet blocks and replace them with an enormous luxury ground-floor extension, with an added moat and a giant basement with a swimming pool - all just metres from the nearest grave

Amber Brammah, who was leading fitness classes from the garage, wanted a new house with more room to run her business, while ecologist husband Martin preferred the idea of renovating. programme.desc: The station shock-jocks decide to play practical jokes - and Frasier's pompous manner makes him the ideal target for their dubious humour. Starring Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce

programme.desc: Frasier and Niles are at loggerheads again over Niles' new job as art critic for a prestigious magazine

programme.title: Be Water
programme.desc: "Be Water" is a harrowing documentary chronicling the life of legendary actor and martial arts master, Bruce Lee. After being rejected from Hollywood, Lee returned to his parent's homeland, Hong Kong, where he'd complete four iconic films in just two years of a short career when he died at the age of 32. "Be Water" takes a look at Lee's early life in San Francisco, the son of a Chinese opera star, and troubled childhood in Hong Kong. At the age of 18, Lee established a following in Seattle by teaching Kung Fu, where he would meet his future wife Linda. When Hollywood was not ready for an Asian leading man, Lee would return to Hong Kong and become an international superstar. A trove of interviews and archival film footage illustrates the tapestry of Lee's charisma, passion, philosophy, and dedication to his art.

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: Military historian Richard Holmes describes the 1815 Battle of Waterloo, visiting fields and farms in Belgium where the confrontation took place. Napoleon's mighty French army suffered a decisive defeat at the hands of a combined British and Prussian force, which brought one of the most powerful European empires since Roman times crashing down

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox examines Saturn, a planet raised in the freezing outer reaches of the solar system that began life as a strange combination of rock and ice. Born outside the snow line, with an abundance of building materials, it soon grew to dwarf Earth, drawing in colossal amounts of the hydrogen and helium that permeated the early solar system. As Nasa's Cassini probe has discovered, the planet remained ring-less most of its life, until a fateful encounter changed everything. Less than a hundred million years ago, one of Saturn's ice moons was drawn too close to the planet. In a truly cataclysmic event, the entire moon was destroyed and the rings were born

programme.title: The Pembrokeshire Coast: A Wild Year
programme.desc: The seasons are marked on Wales' Pembrokeshire's coast by the arrival of the puffins, which court by tapping their multi-coloured bills. Farmers grow the earliest potatoes, while sheep are employed to maintain the clifftop pastures for the rare choughs that use their long red beaks to probe for grubs. As autumn arrives, the grey seals produce their white-coated pups just before the gales mark the might of winter. Using time-lapse techniques, this documentary brings fresh insight into the restless rhythms of the countryside in an exploration of how and why this region is the way it is. Narrated by Toby Jones

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: The steeplejack tours unusual places of worship, beginning in Preston with one of Britain's tallest spires, and a Saxon church in Durham made from the remains of an abandoned Roman fort. programme.title: War Walks

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First into the workshop is Margaret Brier from Yorkshire. She's hoping electronics wizard Mark Stuckey can bring an old homemade gramophone back to life. Now little more than a box of bits, the gramophone was built by Margaret's grandfather Harry Bates in the late 1800s. Harry was ahead of his time, a natural-born engineer with a talent for fixing anything, known in Yorkshire as a 'knackler'. Mark calls in help from the Repair Shop's very own 'jack of all trades', Dom Chinea, to remake the missing papier-mâché horn. Meanwhile, Mark works on reviving the flagging gramophone motor. Together the duo restore the voice of this silent gramophone and get it playing once more.
The next visitor to the barn is 19-year-old Charlotte Hughes, also from Yorkshire. She's hoping ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay can help her atone for an accident that left her mother's piggy bank smashed and shattered into pieces. A well-intentioned attempt to mend it has left unsightly cracks and a gaping hole in piggy's cheek. Along the way he's also lost his cork and trotters. Charlotte is desperate to make it up to her mum, Liz, who was understandably upset when she discovered this important memento from childhood was broken. Ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsey has her work cut out to undo the old repairs and stabilise the cracks. Working her magic to perfect the piggy bank in time for Liz and Charlotte to return to collect it.
Finally, Jay Blades and Brenton West welcome Teresa Oates, and her partner, Ron, to the barn. Theresa wants silversmith Brenton to restore an antique to help someone very dear to her. The couple have brought in a Prussian helmet, the 19th-century German ceremonial helmet is a family heirloom. Teresa's dad, Edward, was a D-Day veteran and soldier during the Allied occupation. He brought the tarnished memento home when he returned from service and Teresa and Ron are hoping that by restoring the helmet they may help Edward (who is suffering from dementia) refresh his memory. Leather expert Suzie Fletcher steps in to create a new skull and chin strap, while Brenton works to revitalize the rusting and tarnished helmet, achieving a stunning transformation.

programme.desc: By the mid thirties, Adolf Hitler's ambitions seemed clear to all. If the great powers had acted earlier, would their intervention have prevented WW2?

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: The plan to end the war in Europe by winter 1944 founders as Allied forces massed on the German border find themselves perilously short of fuel, leading commanders to take a risky gamble and parachute thousands of additional troops behind enemy lines. In the Pacific, General MacArthur heads one of the most brutal campaigns of the conflict while taking the island of Peleliu

programme.title: Grand Tours of the Scottish Islands
programme.desc: Paul Murton explores the Isle of Mull and its satellite islands to discover why they have become boltholes from the hustle and bustle of the modern world. He begins on the tidal island of Erraid, which inspired famous Scottish writer Robert Louis Stevenson, then hops over to Ulva, the final resting place of Lachlan MacQuarrie, one of the first governors of New South Wales. He then explores Mull itself, being given a whistlestop tour of the island by rally driver Louise Thomas, then travels to the mysterious little island of Inch Kenneth, where he hears the story of Nazi sympathizer Unity Mitford. He ends his tour at the remote Treshnish Islands, where he experiences a spot of 'puffin therapy'

programme.title: Pocahontas: Beyond the Myth
programme.desc: The life of the Native American princess, which was anything but a fairy tale. This documentary looks beyond the fiction and reveals the real story of Pocahontas - a tale of kidnapping, conflict, starvation, ocean journeys and the future of an entire civilisation
