programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: Paul Murton follows the course of the River Ythan in rural Aberdeenshire, through a landscape of fields and haunted castles to a coast rich in wildlife. On the way, Paul learns how to make a haystack, speak the Doric dialect, has a ghostly encounter with a woman in Fyvie Castle and visits the ruined home of the poet Lord Byron's family

programme.title: My Husband the MMA Fighter
programme.desc: Professional cage fighter Stevie 'Braveheart' Ray is just one bout away from becoming Scotland's first world champion in the sport. This documentary captures the all-or-nothing tale of the lead-up to a major prize fight - and the aftermath - as told through the eyes of his wife Natalie, a 30-year-old mother of four. The PFL world championship is staged in Madison Square Gardens, New York, and the top prize is a million dollars. However, MMA can be dangerous, with fighters having only a pair of 4oz gloves for protection. Both physical pain and mental health are factors to be considered

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond visits Castlemilk on the southern edge of Glasgow to explores a local nature reserve that has transformed the location from perceived no-go zone to a thriving green place. Arlene Stuart heads to an Aberdeenshire shoemakers' workshop that shut over 80 years ago to meet the locals carefully conserving the shop's contents, while Anne Lundon is on the Black Isle finding out about a charity funded by Children in Need providing bereavement support across the Highlands

programme.title: Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles
programme.desc: In autumn, Hamza heads to the south Devon coast to spot Atlantic bluefin tuna, and pays a night-time visit to London's Highgate Cemetery in search of urban foxes. He also explores a cave system in Northern Ireland, where experts have discovered a hidden species of cave spiders and a fungus that turns the underground arachnids into zombies

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: Cyber cop Archie Pepper gets a new colleague and is soon overcome by red hot passion. Urban beat team Fletcher and McLaren calm down a celebrity fracas in a city centre chip shop. Bobby desperately seeks advice from Officer Karen on his face-covering, while the traffic cops lift a street vigilante planting greenery in potholes

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: Though he is married to the force and justice is his mistress, Miekelson feels the time is right to dip his toe into romantic waters and sets out to explore the singles scene. Though hoping to meet a high-flyer at a similar level to himself, the Chief finds he has a lot to learn about modern dating etiquette. Comedy, starring Jack Docherty, Rhona Cameron and Lana Pheutan

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests

programme.title: Sarah the Lumberjill
programme.desc: Sarah Yeaman is the fourth generation of her family to 'take up the saw' as a lumberjack, working across the forests of the Central Highlands of Scotland, where her family have worked for 150 years. After some of the worst storms to hit Scotland in a lifetime, Sarah, her father Ralph and brother Ralphy are busier than ever - though with Ralph's health in decline, Sarah has a lot to learn before taking over one day. In this Our Lives documentary, Sarah records her day-to-day life

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Forbidden Fruits
programme.desc: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch coven with co-workers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin challenges their sisterhood, forcing the trio to confront their inner darkness. As tensions rise and the coven's secrets threaten to spill, they must face their fears or all meet a violent end. Comedy horror, starring Lili Reinhart

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: Political prisoner Valentín shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency, where an unlikely bond forms between the pair as the latter recounts a glamorous Hollywood movie. Adaptation of the stage musical, based on the novel by Manuel Puig, starring Diego Luna, Jennifer Lopez and Tonatiuh

programme.title: Couples Weekend
programme.desc: Four adults navigate deception and desire when a fallen tree on New Year's Eve triggers a chain of events that challenges their relationships and the lies they tell themselves and each other. Writer/director Nora Kirkpatrick's comedy drama, starring Alexandra Daddario and Daveed Diggs

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Christmas with the Coopers
programme.desc: Four generations of a family meet up to spend Christmas together - and all bring their own problems to the gathering, with a fake boyfriend, an arrest for shoplifting and the demands of single parenthood putting the festive season in jeopardy. Comedy, starring Diane Keaton, John Goodman, Ed Helms and Amanda Seyfried, narrated by Steve Martin as the family dog

programme.title: Scrooged
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy, starring Bill Murray, Karen Allen and featuring Robert Mitchum. Frank Cross, the youngest network president in television history, is a man who hates Christmas and plans to exploit the holidays to attract as many viewers as possible, no matter what it takes. However, Frank is about to be visited by three unconventional ghosts who will go to any lengths to make him change his mean-spirited ways.

programme.title: Jack Frost
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy drama starring Michael Keaton and Kelly Preston. When a neglectful father is killed in a car accident he has the chance to make amends with his son by returning to him in the form of a snowman.

programme.title: SuperKlaus
programme.desc: Santa Claus is excitedly preparing for another busy festive season at the North Pole with his army of helpers, including executive assistant Leo. Action figures of the film character SuperKlaus are especially popular this year, but a blow to the head robs Santa of his memory, and he labours under the illusion that he is SuperKlaus. Can tech-savvy tyke Billie and a robot companion restore Santa's memory before a megalomaniacal businessman takes undeserved ownership of Yuletide? Animated adventure, with the voices of Colm Feore, Harland Williams, Paul Van Dyck and Millie Davis

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voice of James McAvoy. Santa's job of getting presents to all the children in just one night is an operation that requires military precision. But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: Seasonal animated fantasy featuring Tom Hanks. On Christmas Eve, a young boy lies in bed pondering if Santa Claus really exists. Startled by a thunderous sound, he goes outside to discover a magical train destined for the North Pole. As he cautiously climbs on board, he begins an amazing journey that changes his view of the festive season for ever.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: Christmas with the Kranks
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis. After their daughter goes to Peru to serve with the Peace Corps, Luther and Nora Krank face their first Christmas alone. Miserable at the prospect, they decide to completely forget yuletide and go on a Caribbean cruise. But their change of plan doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: Seasonal fantasy comedy starring Melissa McCarthy and Paapa Essiedu. Workaholic Bernard is having a pretty bad Christmas: his wife has left him, he's been fired and he's all alone. But things take a surprising turn when he unwittingly releases a genie from a jewellery box and is granted unlimited wishes. Could Bernard be about to get his life back together?

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: Seasonal animated fantasy featuring Tom Hanks. On Christmas Eve, a young boy lies in bed pondering if Santa Claus really exists. Startled by a thunderous sound, he goes outside to discover a magical train destined for the North Pole. As he cautiously climbs on board, he begins an amazing journey that changes his view of the festive season for ever.

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Black comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates. In a small American town, kindly inventor Rand Peltzer brings home a cute little animal called a mogwai for his son Billy, with three rules for its upkeep: never get the mogwai wet, expose him to light or feed him after midnight. Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. After breaking up with her boyfriend, Los Angeles workaholic Amanda is in need of a holiday. An online search persuades her to exchange her California home over Christmas for the remote Surrey cottage of journalist Iris, who has just found out her ex is getting married. But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. A party of archaeologists, led by American adventurer Rick O'Connell, discover a tomb containing the 3,000-year-old remains of a murderous Egyptian priest, Imhotep. When the mummy is accidentally disturbed, he unleashes his terrifying powers on those who have desecrated his resting place.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical based on the Broadway hit, starring Quvenzhané Wallis, Cameron Diaz and Jamie Foxx. A foster child's life changes after accidentally meeting a workaholic tycoon running for mayor of New York.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Animated comedy spin-off from Madagascar, featuring the guest voices of John Malkovich and Benedict Cumberbatch. Resourceful penguins Skipper, Kowalski, Private and Rico team up with an undercover organisation to stop a malevolent mollusc from destroying the world.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: The Swan Princess: The Secret of the Castle
programme.desc: Animated musical fantasy. As Derek and Odette celebrate one year of marriage, Derek's attention is distracted by the evil Clavius and his plan to steal a globe that holds magic powers.

programme.title: Dr Seuss' The Lorax
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure with the voices of Zac Efron, Ed Helms and Danny DeVito. In a city where everything is artificial, young Ted Wiggins seeks to win the heart of his dream girl Audrey by finding her a real tree. But first he must reverse the destructive work of a greedy businessman with the aid of a grumpy woodland guardian.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Alec Baldwin. When a seven-year-old boy discovers that his baby brother is a spy on a secret mission, he joins forces with his suit-wearing, briefcase-carrying sibling to defeat an evil businessman.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the characters created by EB White, starring Geena Davis and Hugh Laurie, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox as the lovable talking mouse. Stuart loses his heart to a little bird called Margalo when he nurses her back to health following an encounter with a vicious falcon. But his new-found love hides a dark secret.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone. Vietnam veteran John Rambo is tracked down to a Buddhist monastery by his friend Colonel Trautman, who wants help fighting Soviet forces in Afghanistan. Rambo declines, but when Trautman is captured by the Soviets, the one-man army goes into action.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure based on the popular TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The captain and crew of the untested new starship Enterprise travel to the desolate world of Nimbus III after a Vulcan mystic kidnaps a group of Federation diplomats. There, they find themselves caught up in a dangerous quest.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Fantasy horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell and Embeth Davidtz. The second sequel to the original Evil Dead finds Ash back in medieval times and desperate to return to the present. But to do so, it means having to take up arms against an army of familiar old foes.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: Remake of the 1981 fantasy adventure, starring Sam Worthington, Liam Neeson and Ralph Fiennes. Perseus, the demigod son of Zeus, is stirred into vengeful action when Hades kills his adoptive family. But Hades retaliates, not least with a threat to unleash the monstrous Kraken unless Perseus delivers the beautiful princess Andromeda to him.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman. Three years after the attack on the White House, Mike Banning is back in the Secret Service and travels to London with President Benjamin Asher for the Prime Minister's funeral. The world's leaders are also in attendance but little do they know that a plot to assassinate them and capture Asher is about to come to fruition... with catastrophic results.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Vin Diesel, Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Charlize Theron. The whole team have dispersed to live quieter lives. But with Dom seemingly seduced into a life of techno terrorism by the mysterious Cipher, it looks like the opportunity to put their feet up will have to wait.

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Idris Elba. Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Risqué teen comedy starring Tom Cruise and Rebecca De Mornay. Left to safeguard the family home while his parents are away, promising student Joel Goodson seizes the chance to have the time of his life. But when a friend's prank results in Joel being visited by troubled prostitute Lana, things get out of hand.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Smith and Eva Mendes. Alex "Hitch" Hitchens is a professional and deliberately anonymous New York "date doctor" who helps male clients woo the women of their dreams. But his success leads to trouble when tenacious gossip columnist Sara Melas decides to unmask him.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Canine comedy featuring the voice of Owen Wilson. When the family of irrepressible Great Dane Marmaduke moves to a new home in California, it all proves to be something of a culture shock for the hapless hound, who continues to wreak havoc wherever he goes.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Mulholland Drive
programme.desc: Psychological thriller directed by David Lynch, starring Naomi Watts, Laura Elena Harring and Justin Theroux. An aspiring actress lands in Hollywood and is quickly drawn into the mystery of an amnesiac woman who has arrived at her lodgings. Meanwhile, a director battles sinister forces to try to complete his latest film.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Prison drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman. Maine 1946: sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife and her lover, mild-mannered banker Andy Dufresne tries to adapt to the brutalities of prison life. Over the years, Dufresne's friendship with long-term inmate Red and the discovery that his financial expertise is suddenly in big demand make his ordeal easier to bear.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Tow
programme.desc: Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman, attempts to fight her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a huge tow bill. Fact-based drama, starring Rose Byrne, Jason Cottle and Elsie Fisher

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Ken Russell's satirical adaptation of the rock opera written by Pete Townshend and the Who, starring Roger Daltrey, Oliver Reed and Ann-Margret. A few months after her husband goes missing during the Second World War, Nora Walker gives birth to a son whom she names Tommy. Later, the boy is rendered deaf, dumb and blind and all efforts to cure Tommy fail. However, his life is transformed when he discovers pinball.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: Ray Stoker and his brother Jem have been estranged for 20 years, haunted by a shared history scarred with violence. Ray now lives in a primitive cabin in the woods in self-imposed exile while Jem has fought refuge in his faith and the love of his partner Nessa and their son Brian. An unexpected family crisis compels Jem to seek out Ray and face the ghosts of the past. Director Ronan Day-Lewis's drama, starring Sean Bean, Daniel Day-Lewis and Samantha Morton

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: Failed actress Lucy Mason is a star employee of the Adore matchmaking agency. She prefers the life of a singleton after her previous relationship with actor John imploded because of his precarious finances. At a client's wedding, Lucy meets the groom's brother, Harry, and politely rebuffs his amorous advances, suggesting he should enrol with Adore. Harry persists and Lucy agrees to go on a date, on condition that he signs up with the agency after their lunchtime liaison. Writer/director Celine Song's romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Chris Evans and Pedro Pascal

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Ken Russell's satirical adaptation of the rock opera written by Pete Townshend and the Who, starring Roger Daltrey, Oliver Reed and Ann-Margret. A few months after her husband goes missing during the Second World War, Nora Walker gives birth to a son whom she names Tommy. Later, the boy is rendered deaf, dumb and blind and all efforts to cure Tommy fail. However, his life is transformed when he discovers pinball.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: Ray Stoker and his brother Jem have been estranged for 20 years, haunted by a shared history scarred with violence. Ray now lives in a primitive cabin in the woods in self-imposed exile while Jem has fought refuge in his faith and the love of his partner Nessa and their son Brian. An unexpected family crisis compels Jem to seek out Ray and face the ghosts of the past. Director Ronan Day-Lewis's drama, starring Sean Bean, Daniel Day-Lewis and Samantha Morton

programme.title: Tow
programme.desc: Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman, attempts to fight her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a huge tow bill. Fact-based drama, starring Rose Byrne, Jason Cottle and Elsie Fisher

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Comedy drama, based on the true story of conman Frank Abagnale Jr, starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Idris Elba. Grieving widower Dr Nate Samuels takes his two daughters to a South African game reserve, hoping that the trip will be a healing experience for them. But when the family crosses paths with a huge, rogue lion, Nate realises that the predator will stop at nothing to claim its prey.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: A Scottish teenager travels to America at the end of the 19th century. He travels across the frontier in the hope of being reunited with the woman he loves, aided in his travels by a mysterious drifter and stalked through the wilderness by an outlaw. Western, starring Kodi Smit-McPhee and Michael Fassbender

programme.title: In Fear
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Iain De Caestecker and Alice Englert. Young couple Tom amd Lucy are driving to a music festival in Ireland and plan to stay at a remote country hotel overnight. But the signposts lead them in circles and, as darkness falls and the weather takes a turn for the worse, it soon becomes apparent that someone - or something - else is out in the woods with them.

programme.title: Leave Her to Heaven
programme.desc: Crime melodrama starring Gene Tierney and Cornel Wilde. Beautiful Ellen Berent falls obsessively in love with Richard Harland, an author who resembles her dead father. But Ellen's jealousy of anyone who attracts Harland's friendship has deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Longest Day
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Wayne, Robert Mitchum, Henry Fonda and Robert Ryan. Normandy, 6 June 1944: as the huge task of preparing for D-Day draws to a close, the Allied commanders await suitable weather conditions to set in motion history's greatest amphibious operation.

programme.title: The Man from Colorado
programme.desc: Psychological western starring Glenn Ford and William Holden. When unstable Civil War veteran Owen Devereaux becomes a judge in Colorado, his marshal, Del Stewart, tries to keep his ex-army colleague's psychotic tendencies under control.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: Wartime action drama starring Owen Wilson and Gene Hackman. During a reconnaissance mission over Bosnia, US serviceman Chris Burnett is shot down after photographing evidence of activity in a demilitarised zone. Abandoned by Nato peacekeepers, who believe a rescue mission would threaten the fragile ceasefire, Burnett's only hope is a determined commanding officer who refuses to desert a comrade.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Chris Pine and Zachary Quinto. Rebellious youth James Kirk is persuaded to join the Starfleet Academy, where he befriends Dr Leonard "Bones" McCoy and clashes with officer Spock. When an evil Romulan arrives from the future, the young crew of the USS Enterprise find themselves in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Aaron Eckhart and Hilary Swank. When the Earth's core stops rotating, mankind suffers a series of disasters, including devastating electrical storms and exposure to solar radiation. A top team of scientists is assembled to design and pilot a machine to burrow to the centre of the Earth and set the core spinning again.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Ralph Fiennes. Nearly three decades after the outbreak of a devastating rage virus, the British Isles remain in quarantine. Married couple Isla and Jamie, along with their young son, are part of a community living in safety on Lindisfarne. However, Isla is seriously ill, and only one person can help: the mysterious Dr Kelson, who lives on the mainland among the infected.

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Year of the Gun
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Andrew McCarthy, Sharon Stone and Valeria Golino. An American journalist working in Italy becomes a target for terrorists when his draft for a novel predicts a real-life Red Brigade plot to kidnap the Italian prime minister.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: An explosive, all-out-action cyber-thriller starring action megastar Bruce Willis with Jesse Metcalfe (Escape Plan II) and Chad Michael Murray (Riverdale). Weeks after the deadly assault on Fortress Camp, Robert (Willis) makes a daring rescue to save Sasha, the widow of his old nemesis Balzary (Murray). But back in the camp's command bunker, it appears Sasha may have devious plans of her own.

programme.title: Dark Storm
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Stephen Baldwin. A government experiment with "dark matter" goes awry, leaving lead scientist Daniel Gray with some unexpected new abilities.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: After the treehouse is raided by a monkey, Roxton and Marguerite track the culprit to a cave. There, they discover a strange amulet that marks them with a tattoo of a dinosaur skull. This imprint seems to provoke some primal instincts from the explorers as they morph into their more beast-like selves. Overcome by a power that science can't explain, the group begins to exhibit heightened senses.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Buying goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Age of the Dragons
programme.desc: A young adventurer joins a band of dragon hunters, who slay the vast flying monsters to sell their valuable vitriol. The leader of the group is obsessed with killing the dragon that wiped out his family and left him horribly disfigured, and his quest for revenge threatens the lives of his crew. Fantasy adventure inspired by Moby Dick, starring Danny Glover and Vinnie Jones

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
Love Monster is finishing the preparations for his pool party when he notices a very small leak in his inflatable pool. As Love Monster inspects the leak, Bad Idea Puppy, Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny and Delivery Duckling arrive ready for the party. Love Monster thinks he could tape the leak up quickly but doesn't want to miss out on the fun with his friends, so he leaves it.
Love Monster, Bad Idea Puppy and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny have fun playing in the pool, but when Love Monster borrows Bad Idea Puppy's scuba mask, he sees that the water level is going down. Love Monster notices that the leak is getting worse, but before he can fix it, Bad Idea Puppy asks him to play some music so he can dance. Love Monster says he will fix the leak after one dance. He starts the music, and Bad Idea Puppy challenges him to a dance-off. The pair have fun trying to out-dance each other, but then Love Monster slips in a puddle caused by the leak.
He looks at the leak but gets distracted again by Delivery Duckling hitting a volleyball his way. Wanting to join in the fun, Love Monster says he'll fix the leak after a game. Love Monster and Delivery Duckling play volleyball, but their game is cut short when Love Monster slips on a bigger puddle caused by the leak. Caught in the volleyball net, Love Monster scoots across the ground towards the leak like a worm, accidentally dragging the snack table along with him too. He tries to plug the hole in the pool with his finger, but it's too late: the rest of the water comes gushing out, the pool rips and Love Monster floats away on the grass.
The party is ruined, and Love Monster is upset, but his friends comfort him and help him tidy up. Love Monster picks up a long strip of the ripped rubber pool, and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny is on the other end. She slips and slides down, which gives her an idea for the party. The friends work together to construct a fun slip-and-slide out of the ripped pool, and they take turns sliding down. When it's Love Monster's turn, a small tear appears in the slide. This time he fixes it straight away rather than put it off!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Sula a' tadhal air Bing 's i air a h-aodann a pheantadh mar dhealan-dè, tha i airson aodann Bing a' pheantadh cuideachd. Chaneil am peantadh a' dol ro mhath ach tha e sealbhach gu bheil Flop ri làimh airson gnothaichean a rèiteachadh.
When Sula visits Bing with her face painted like a butterfly, she also wants to face paint Bing. But the painting doesn't go well for them. Fortunately, Flop is on hand to sort it all out.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Tha Bing brònach nuair a thèid innse dha, an-dèidh dha a' bhanachdach fhaighinn, nach eil gin de na steigearan sònraichte as fheàrr leis air fhàgail. Tha cùisean ag atharrachadh ge-tà nuair a tha e a' faighinn teisteanas grinn, sònraichte.
Bing is sad when he is told, after having had his vaccination, that there are none of his favourite stickers left at Dr Molly's surgery. He soon cheers up though when he is given a very special certificate instead.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc:
Tha na h-Abadas air bothan a dhèanamh anns an taigh agus a' faighinn tòrr spòrs bho bhith cluich anns an uisge. Tha facal an là-an-diugh co-cheangailte ri cumail tioram, cuideachd. Dè th'ann agus càite an lorg iad e?
The Abadas have made a den inside the house and are having a lot of fun playing in the rain. Today's word has something to do with keeping dry, too. What could it be and where will they find it?

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop a' leantainn oirre 's i gar toirt tro cheumannan a bharrachd ann a bhith ag ionnsachadh na Gàidhlig. Bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean làitheil agus, mar thè a dh'ionnsaich na Gàidhlig i fhèin, bheir Joy mìneachadh dhuinn air briathrachas, gràmar is gnathasan-cainnte ann an dòigh a tha furasta a thuigsinn.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh a th' air Gàidhlig ionnsachadh gu àrd ìre neo a thogadh leis a' Ghàidhlig air falbh bho sgìrean traidiseanta na Gàidhealtachd, agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh dhuinn air annasan is cuspairean 's e air chuairt air feadh na dùthcha.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot, ann am pod-chraolaidhean SpeakGaelic air BBC Sounds agus tha na prògraman air fad rin lorg le fo-thiotalan air sianal YouTube SpeakGaelic.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to keep on speaking Gaelic. As in previous series, she introduces and explains usage for words and phrases on everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through vocabulary, grammar and idiom on topics such as medicine, politics, community and exercise.
Speakers who have embraced the language join in, and the intrepid Calum Maclean ventures to forgotten corners of Scotland seeking hidden treasures.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot, in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds and with English subtitles on SpeakGaelic's YouTube channel.
