programme.desc: Daisy loses her voice before a frog show. Her pals gather lemon, honey, and tea to make a warm drink that soothes her throat and helps her get her voice back.

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Daisy May Cooper, Johnny Vegas, Katherine Parkinson, Mawaan Rizwan and Richard Herring take on a number of ludicrous challenges, hoping to walk away with their reputations intact. Mawaan is not at all fazed when faced with a task involving office chairs, chickens and remote control cars, although the same cannot be said of his rivals. Daisy tries to decipher mysterious messages from Richard, and Katherine is baffled by a giant marble

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts as Rob Beckett, Sara Pascoe, Oti Mabuse, Rylan Clark, Russell Kane and Maisie Adam compete.

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts, with Sean Lock and Stephen Mangan taking on guest captain Richard Ayoade and Katherine Ryan. Bill Bailey is in Dictionary Corner with Susie Dent, while Rachel Riley is in charge of the letters and numbers

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Daisy May Cooper, Johnny Vegas, Katherine Parkinson, Mawaan Rizwan and Richard Herring take on a number of ludicrous challenges, hoping to walk away with their reputations intact. Mawaan is not at all fazed when faced with a task involving office chairs, chickens and remote control cars, although the same cannot be said of his rivals. Daisy tries to decipher mysterious messages from Richard, and Katherine is baffled by a giant marble

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: President of Moe's Southwest Grill, Paul Damico, goes undercover to check the standards he values are still being met. The company is one of the world's fastest growing restaurant chains with 10,000 employees and Paul wants to look for opportunities to assist his staff in a similar way to how his family were helped by his father's bosses during his childhood

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Sara Bittorf goes undercover among the workforce of restaurant chain Boston Market, where she is chief brand officer. Disguising herself as an out-of-work waitress trying to win the chance to open up her own eatery by taking part in a bogus reality TV show, she tries to revive the company's image by learning more about its staff

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Bromley, south-east London, Jo and her discerning foodie partner Alex kick off proceedings with a fine dining menu but the guests are not impressed. Day two sees Ryan and Julie go back to their roots cooking up an Americana menu, but the food fails to wow with Michelle comparing the main course to vomit. Finally it's the turn of Michelle and confident Craig, who give their guests a taste of the Caribbean

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples host dinner parties in Dartford and Beckenham, Kent. Jamie and his fiancée Carol kick off the competition with a party themed evening, inspired by their passion for all things 'crazy'. Unfortunately for them, a dessert proves almost inedible. Day two sees champagne lovers Paul and Justin hosting an international menu inspired by their extensive travels. Finally it's cockney couple Richard and Julie's chance to impress with a technical dessert and flavours designed to appeal to a mature palette

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Harry Potter fan Sean tries to plan a spooky witches and wizards-themed wedding for his bride-to-be Nicole, but with his demanding fiancee all set on a church service for her big day and a best man who would rather watch football than help to plan the occasion, can the groom pull it off?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Inked-up groom Adam plans a wedding at the London tattoo convention for his bride Dani, who has her heart set on a more traditional, intimate day with her family and friends in the grounds of a castle near their home in Devon

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Kenny tiptoes down memory lane, Brandi and Jarrod get to work on a tool locker, while Darrell and his granddaughter dig up a creepy find

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The buyers lose their minds in West Covina, California. Kenny hunts for cougars, but finds a portable pulpit instead. Ivy shows the ladies how to dress for success

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Paul Quentel, president of Alfred Angelo, the second largest bridal retailer in the United States, goes undercover to solve any problems as quickly as possible. Posing as a contestant on a reality TV competition, he works among his own staff

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Mike Bloom, president and COO of discount retail chain Family Dollar, intends to double its number of stores within a few years. He decides that to do so he first needs to go incognito within the organisation to monitor where the firm is excelling and where it needs improvement

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Alfonso Ribeiro presents light-hearted entertainment and family-friendly laughs, as viewers' home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. Easter funnies, including a dad who pranks his kids by eating their candy. Plus, people getting soaked and pathetic athletics, including a golfer who gets attacked by a bird

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Dave brings his mentor with him to Rancho Cucamonga, but has little to show for it. Brandi and Jarrod go all in on a hunch, Kenny tries to downsize his strategy, while Ivy shows a skeptical Emily how he pulls a win out of a locker

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Vegas Ladies discover that one of them has Texas flair, Kenny lucks out looking for lady stuff; and Mary gets the spring back in her step.

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: The latest charter guests are a gang of adrenaline junkies - and they're quick to test the crew's boundaries. A disgruntled stew gets sassy with Captain Jason

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef travels to Philadelphia to help failing Mexican restaurant Zocalo. Owners Greg and Mary Russell met and fell in love while they were working there, and the place held such sentimental importance to them they pooled their money and bought it. Now Gordon tries to turn things around before the floundering business ruins their marriage and tears their family apart

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, in an attempt to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over Spin a Yarn in 1995 and began to turn it into a success, before marrying bartender Jennifer. When the business started to fail, the couple decided to splash out on refurbishments to recover their glory days, but their efforts have been futile and now their relationship is at stake

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with Kathy Burke and Roisin Conaty taking on Johnny Vegas and Bob Mortimer. John Cooper Clarke joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with captain Jon Richardson joined by Sara Pascoe to take on his opposite number Sean Lock, assisted by Vic Reeves. David O'Doherty joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley takes care of the letters and numbers

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Greg Davies presents another assortment of absurd assignments, as Alex Horne tries to ignore Richard Herring hiding menacingly in a bush, Katherine Parkinson pays a visit to the fridge, Mawaan Rizwan steals a cup of tea and Johnny Vegas takes a tumble

programme.title: Dating Naked
programme.desc: Chris and Carrie play volleyball, while Kerri is distracted from her keeper by two alternatives

programme.title: Naked Attraction's Best Naughty Bits
programme.desc: A romp through the Naked Attraction archive to catch up with dates that led to full-on romances - as well as some that turned out to be a disaster. They include Wolverhampton DJ Darryl from series one, who found his partner in Maria, and Scottish bombshell Amira from series five, who gives the lowdown on what really happened between her and Ste after their night of passion

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including The Great British Bake Off, Strictly Come Dancing, Celebrity SAS: Who Dares Wins, Sex Education, Blankety Blank, Celebrity Race Across the World, Love & Death, and Ambulance

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: It's the final night of the charter, but there's still heaps of drama to dish out with a captain's reprimand, an unlikely hookup and another huge argument

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Gregory's shocked when kids start hanging out in his classroom at lunch, asking for his advice and treating him as the cool teacher. Barbara's shocked when Tariq dates a student's mum. And Janine and Jacob try to hire a sign language interpreter

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer stages a revolt against moves to give Springfield a new telephone dialling code, stirring up public indignation and splitting the town down the middle. Featuring the guest voices of the Who and Gary Coleman

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Animated comedy set in Springfield

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Afraid that she'll be left alone in her old age, Beverly seeks her children's advice on assembling a circle of friends for her later years and attempts to bond with other mothers to form their own group like The Golden Girls. Geoff's romantic gestures begin to annoy Erica, but when she tries to reciprocate, she almost brings their relationship to an end

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited
programme.desc: Liam took inspiration from his favourite movie, Men in Black, for his wedding to Lynn in 2013. Now, the couple, the best man and one of the bridesmaids remember their out of this world big day.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Dunphys are sent into a panic when a loud, obnoxious couple come to look at the house next door. Jay is furious to learn that Manny is dating the granddaughter of his biggest business rival, while Mitch and Cam take on Lily's tyrannical teacher, Mrs Plank. Steve Zahn and Andrea Anders join the cast as new neighbours Ronnie and Amber, with guest star Tyne Daly

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Halloween is Claire's favourite holiday, but this year she is snowed under at work, so she allows Phil to take over the house-decorating duties - a decision she soon comes to regret. Jay isn't too happy with the Shrek costume Gloria picked out for him so makes a last-minute change, and soon becomes attached to his new outfit, while Mitch's attempt to escape from a work slump hits a stumbling block

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: Comedy clips showcasing amusing internet videos featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorcycle and bicycle variety

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The first hosts in Sheffield, Ray and Chloe, reckon their French cuisine will help them bag the money, but they're in for a rocky ride. On day two, Andrew and Claire want to push the boat out for their first ever dinner party. However, criticism of their unusual menu causes Andrew to bite back, and things don't improve when he does his Mr Bean impressions. On the last night, food connoisseurs Rob and Emma plan a fine dining menu, but suffer a few unfortunate mishaps in the kitchen. It seems set to be a tight finish and remains unclear who will pocket the £1,000 prize right up to the announcement

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to the Park's Edge restaurant in Atlanta, Georgia, where a series of spats with the local community are hampering its success. Owners Richard and Jorge's in-fighting has alienated locals, and the duo's suggestion that customer numbers are low because of racism has heightened tensions

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to the Greek at the Harbour restaurant in southern California, where owner Makis Mikelatos works 17 hours a day, seven days a week, but is unwilling to let his son Ari take the reins. Gordon sets out to get to the bottom of Makis's reluctance to teach his son, and uncovers a shocking family secret

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Kids and adults end up with egg on their face in Easter disasters. Plus, the perils of a drive-through safari. And how not to use a bug zapper

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will's mother decides to drop by for the Thanksgiving celebrations, but is decidedly unimpressed with the new lifestyle her son has adopted. Comedy, starring Will Smith and Janet Hubert-Whitten

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will gets wind of cousin Hilary's plan to drop out of college, and decides to exploit the situation by blackmailing her into becoming his personal slave. Streetwise comedy, starring Will Smith and Karyn Parsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is down in the dumps, until Lisa wins him a hi-tech computer tablet in the school raffle - and it soon becomes impossible for him to put it down, as every waking minute he finds himself stroking or jabbing the shiny touchscreen. However, disaster strikes when he breaks the device, sending him spiralling back down into the depths of despair. But when Ned Flanders discovers the word 'Hope' written on a tree trunk in the Simpsons' garden, Homer believes it to be a miracle and his faith in life is restored - although newsman Kent Brockman isn't quite so convinced

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer shakes off the shackles of his traditional lifestyle after hitting it off with his trendy new neighbours, who are the ultimate in cool - although Marge isn't too keen on the hipster clan, especially their parenting style. However, when Bart falls out with one of his new friends' kids, the doughnut-loving dad soon sees them for what they really are. With the guest voices of Portlandia stars Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein, and Patton Oswalt (Young Adult)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer doesn't seem to care when Santa's Little Helper goes missing, puzzling the rest of his family who are all panicking about their missing pooch. So Grampa shares a story about his son, a certain childhood pet and a more youthful but no-less-bitter Mr Burns

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A trip to an amusement park ends in disarray, prompting Homer to question the behaviour of his fellow man - and leading to an invitation for him to join a survivalist group preparing for the end of the world. As usual, it's left to Marge to talk some sense into her hubby. Featuring the guest voice of music legend Tom Waits

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam and Murray fall out over Adam's plans to pursue a comedy career after his attempts to be funny in woodwork class nearly result in his teacher getting injured. Beverly and Geoff worry that college is turning Erica into a pretentious snob, but they allow Barry to coach them in the finer points of culture in an attempt to stay close to her

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry looks to secure a spot on the high school football team but is quickly consigned to the bench by Coach Mellor for his lack of sporting prowess. Adam decides to help his brother understand that there are other ways he can contribute to the squad's success

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The return of the American comedy about a man and his extended family living in three different households. Recent events force Haley and Andy to cope with their emotions in different ways, while Jay and Gloria are in for a shock when they start looking for a pre-school for Joe. Plus, Cam attempts to remain supportive of Mitch's midlife career crisis, but when money begins to get tight, he hatches a plan. Ed O'Neill Stars

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil and Claire feel rejected when Alex deliberately tells them the wrong date for her moving-in day at college as she wants to keep things as low-key as possible, while Luke makes it clear he would rather hang out with schoolfriends than spend the day with his dad. Elsewhere, the rest of the family come up with an elaborate excuse to avoid going to Lily's football game, and things get stressful for Mitch and Cam now after they decided to rent out their top floor

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil helps Haley persuade Claire to let Dylan move in, but he soon has second thoughts after he discovers just what living with him really means. Meanwhile, Mitch takes on a much-needed new role working for Jay's business rivals Closets, Closets, Closets, Closets! and Gloria and Cameron come to blows over how to deal with Manny's problem at school.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil goes into nesting mode after finding some abandoned duck eggs, while Mitchell worries about Cam's friendship with a group of frat boys. American comedy following the lives of three dysfunctional households, starring Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart falls in love with the daughter of film star Rainier Wolfcastle, but their romance falters and she ends up going out with Milhouse in a bid to make him jealous. With the voices of Reese Witherspoon and chef Wolfgang Puck

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Fleeing a dog that hates him for no reason, Bart meets a faded Western star. With Marge's help, Bart tries to get him off booze and start him on a better life.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Members of the family appear as characters in a trilogy of classical stories. Bart plays Hamlet trying to avenge his father's death, Lisa pits the French against the English as Joan of Arc, and Homer acts the part of Ulysses in the Odyssey

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The family visits Brazil to find a missing orphan Lisa has been sponsoring, leaving Maggie under the watchful eyes of Patty and Selma - but it is not long before Homer is kidnapped and held to ransom by bandits

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Krusty learns he has a long-lost daughter, but ruins any chances of a happy family life by gambling away her most prized possession in a high-stakes poker game. Featuring the guest voices of Drew Barrymore, John Updike, Amy Tam and Stephen King

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Ava notices that not everything is rosy in Barbara's church choir group. Gregory is worried about Jacob and Zach's relationship. Melissa asks Janine to help her investigate an apparently unqualified new substitute teacher

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: A scuffle at a downtown pool hall almost sees Will lose the family Mercedes, but thankfully his uncle is on hand to bail him out. Guest starring JD Hall

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Carlton accepts a dangerous challenge from Will to prove that he is just as streetwise as his cousin by staying in a rough Los Angeles neighbourhood

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Love is Blind, Strictly Come Dancing, Boiling Point, HELP! My House is Haunted, All Creatures Great and Small and Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on Big Brother: The Launch, Don't Look Down for SU2C, Antiques Roadshow, Coronation Street, Big Little Journeys, Beat the Chasers Celebrity Special and Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg. From October 2023

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Idris Elba. Grieving widower Dr Nate Samuels takes his two daughters to a South African game reserve, hoping that the trip will be a healing experience for them. But when the family crosses paths with a huge, rogue lion, Nate realises that the predator will stop at nothing to claim its prey.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: A Scottish teenager travels to America at the end of the 19th century. He travels across the frontier in the hope of being reunited with the woman he loves, aided in his travels by a mysterious drifter and stalked through the wilderness by an outlaw. Western, starring Kodi Smit-McPhee and Michael Fassbender

programme.title: In Fear
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Iain De Caestecker and Alice Englert. Young couple Tom amd Lucy are driving to a music festival in Ireland and plan to stay at a remote country hotel overnight. But the signposts lead them in circles and, as darkness falls and the weather takes a turn for the worse, it soon becomes apparent that someone - or something - else is out in the woods with them.

programme.title: Leave Her to Heaven
programme.desc: Crime melodrama starring Gene Tierney and Cornel Wilde. Beautiful Ellen Berent falls obsessively in love with Richard Harland, an author who resembles her dead father. But Ellen's jealousy of anyone who attracts Harland's friendship has deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Longest Day
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Wayne, Robert Mitchum, Henry Fonda and Robert Ryan. Normandy, 6 June 1944: as the huge task of preparing for D-Day draws to a close, the Allied commanders await suitable weather conditions to set in motion history's greatest amphibious operation.

programme.title: The Man from Colorado
programme.desc: Psychological western starring Glenn Ford and William Holden. When unstable Civil War veteran Owen Devereaux becomes a judge in Colorado, his marshal, Del Stewart, tries to keep his ex-army colleague's psychotic tendencies under control.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: Wartime action drama starring Owen Wilson and Gene Hackman. During a reconnaissance mission over Bosnia, US serviceman Chris Burnett is shot down after photographing evidence of activity in a demilitarised zone. Abandoned by Nato peacekeepers, who believe a rescue mission would threaten the fragile ceasefire, Burnett's only hope is a determined commanding officer who refuses to desert a comrade.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Idris Elba. Grieving widower Dr Nate Samuels takes his two daughters to a South African game reserve, hoping that the trip will be a healing experience for them. But when the family crosses paths with a huge, rogue lion, Nate realises that the predator will stop at nothing to claim its prey.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: A Scottish teenager travels to America at the end of the 19th century. He travels across the frontier in the hope of being reunited with the woman he loves, aided in his travels by a mysterious drifter and stalked through the wilderness by an outlaw. Western, starring Kodi Smit-McPhee and Michael Fassbender

programme.title: In Fear
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Iain De Caestecker and Alice Englert. Young couple Tom amd Lucy are driving to a music festival in Ireland and plan to stay at a remote country hotel overnight. But the signposts lead them in circles and, as darkness falls and the weather takes a turn for the worse, it soon becomes apparent that someone - or something - else is out in the woods with them.

programme.title: Leave Her to Heaven
programme.desc: Crime melodrama starring Gene Tierney and Cornel Wilde. Beautiful Ellen Berent falls obsessively in love with Richard Harland, an author who resembles her dead father. But Ellen's jealousy of anyone who attracts Harland's friendship has deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Longest Day
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Wayne, Robert Mitchum, Henry Fonda and Robert Ryan. Normandy, 6 June 1944: as the huge task of preparing for D-Day draws to a close, the Allied commanders await suitable weather conditions to set in motion history's greatest amphibious operation.

programme.title: The Man from Colorado
programme.desc: Psychological western starring Glenn Ford and William Holden. When unstable Civil War veteran Owen Devereaux becomes a judge in Colorado, his marshal, Del Stewart, tries to keep his ex-army colleague's psychotic tendencies under control.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: Wartime action drama starring Owen Wilson and Gene Hackman. During a reconnaissance mission over Bosnia, US serviceman Chris Burnett is shot down after photographing evidence of activity in a demilitarised zone. Abandoned by Nato peacekeepers, who believe a rescue mission would threaten the fragile ceasefire, Burnett's only hope is a determined commanding officer who refuses to desert a comrade.

programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First into the workshop is Margaret Brier from Yorkshire. She's hoping electronics wizard Mark Stuckey can bring an old homemade gramophone back to life. Now little more than a box of bits, the gramophone was built by Margaret's grandfather Harry Bates in the late 1800s. Harry was ahead of his time, a natural-born engineer with a talent for fixing anything, known in Yorkshire as a 'knackler'. Mark calls in help from the Repair Shop's very own 'jack of all trades', Dom Chinea, to remake the missing papier-mâché horn. Meanwhile, Mark works on reviving the flagging gramophone motor. Together the duo restore the voice of this silent gramophone and get it playing once more.
The next visitor to the barn is 19-year-old Charlotte Hughes, also from Yorkshire. She's hoping ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay can help her atone for an accident that left her mother's piggy bank smashed and shattered into pieces. A well-intentioned attempt to mend it has left unsightly cracks and a gaping hole in piggy's cheek. Along the way he's also lost his cork and trotters. Charlotte is desperate to make it up to her mum, Liz, who was understandably upset when she discovered this important memento from childhood was broken. Ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsey has her work cut out to undo the old repairs and stabilise the cracks. Working her magic to perfect the piggy bank in time for Liz and Charlotte to return to collect it.
Finally, Jay Blades and Brenton West welcome Teresa Oates, and her partner, Ron, to the barn. Theresa wants silversmith Brenton to restore an antique to help someone very dear to her. The couple have brought in a Prussian helmet, the 19th-century German ceremonial helmet is a family heirloom. Teresa's dad, Edward, was a D-Day veteran and soldier during the Allied occupation. He brought the tarnished memento home when he returned from service and Teresa and Ron are hoping that by restoring the helmet they may help Edward (who is suffering from dementia) refresh his memory. Leather expert Suzie Fletcher steps in to create a new skull and chin strap, while Brenton works to revitalize the rusting and tarnished helmet, achieving a stunning transformation.

programme.desc: The chef heads to the north-eastern Greek city of Thessaloniki, which nestles on the northern shores of the Aegean Sea. The city is revered as the gourmet capital of Greece and birthplace to possibly the greatest warrior general that ever lived - Alexander. Rick explores a city of many identities, boasting a young student population apparently hungry for dishes that reflect the freshest of seafood. programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef visits Palermo in northern Sicily, a city echoing Arab, North African, French, Spanish and Italian influences, making its cuisine unique and irresistible. Pine nuts, raisins, almonds and golden breadcrumbs are combined with flavours of sun-ripened tomatoes, lemons and the finest olive oil to create a range of unforgettable dishes. Rick witnesses locals celebrating a festival in honour of Palermo's patron saint Rosalia, and receives a cookery lesson from a real-life duchess. At home he cooks Marsala chicken, a Sicilian classic served in UK bistros since the 1960s

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo falls into line with the University of Glasgow's Officer Training Corps, where he joins students for drill. The political pundit then heads west along the Firth of Clyde to Helensburgh, where he discovers a pioneering group of artists known as the Glasgow Boys. The idyllic West Highland Line takes Michael deep into the Highlands to Inveraray and the ancestral home of the Clan Campbell and Dukes of Argyll. Michael's final stop is Connel Ferry, near Oban, where, on the Achnacloich Estate, he discovers a Highland calf whose breed has become an icon of the Highlands

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a journey from the Midlands to Rye in East Sussex. At Cowley, he marvels at an automated state-of-the-art production line that produces 1,000 Minis a day. Michael probes the pre-First World War origins of the Morris Oxford and is delighted to find that cars for export are loaded in Italian Job style on to trains at the factory's own railhead

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo picks up his rail journey from Warwick to Rye. programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's journey through California takes him to San Francisco, where he travels through the city's streets by cable car, before heading across the bay to Sausalito

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Yosemite National Park in California, beholding its towering granite cliffs, giant sequoia trees and cascading waterfalls. He then heads to the University of California's seismology department to hear about the devastating 1906 San Francisco earthquake, which claimed the lives of approximately 3,000 people and destroyed more than 80 per cent of the city

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the port of Monterey, he discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage, before heading to Paso de Robles, where he tours Hearst Castle, dream home of the newspaper baron, William Randolph Hearst. In the hills of Morro Bay, Michael joins avocado farmer, Jim Shanley, amid his 4,000 avocado trees to harvest the pears and learn how to make guacamole. Arriving in Los Angeles, Michael heads for the Warner Brothers studio, founded on Sunset Boulevard

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his tour of Los Angeles, joining the locals for Mexican Independence Day, and discovering the secrets of backyard oil drilling in a county that is home to the largest urban oil field in the US. Moving on to Laguna Beach, he learns how artists from the east coast travelled west on the Transcontinental Railroad to found a colony of painters attracted by the beautiful coastline and glorious light to paint outside

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, learning how surgery was first made bearable in 1846 by a miraculous new substance. In Salem, he gets a taste of the witch hunts and the hysteria that gripped the town in the 17th century, before visiting the former home of Little Women author Louisa May Alcott in Concord

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads for Plymouth, where he learns about the indigenous tribes of Wampanoag people, before boarding the Cape Cod Central heritage bound for Hyannis. Finally, he makes his way to the island of Nantucket, where he discovers how New Englanders made vast fortunes from whale oil, before heading to join conservationists and whale watchers at sea

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: In Montreal, Michael Portillo discovers how French and British colonial roots have influenced the city's construction, cuisine and culture. Undaunted by his guidebook's description of the treacherous Lachine Rapids, the one-time MP gets a thorough soaking on a white-knuckle boat ride down the St. Lawrence River. In the Canadian capital, Ottawa, Michael visits the country's parliament to hear about the birth of the new nation after Confederation in 1867. And at Ottawa's historic Central Experimental Farm, Michael hears of the pioneering discoveries, which launched a Canadian wheat boom

programme.title: Inside Bentley: A Great British Motorcar

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo tells the story of how a small island on the edge of Europe built the biggest empire the world has ever seen. In the first episode, Michael travels to India to uncover how the British East India Company - the world's first multinational corporation - raised a private army to create an empire. Beginning his journey in the slums of Kolkata, he explores the ruins of the grand residence of Clive of India, who became the undisputed ruler of Bengal - amassing a vast personal fortune and making millions for shareholders in Britain

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey

The island needed a new source of wealth, and found it in the triangular trade as slaves were shipped from Africa to work sugar plantations. programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo falls into line with the University of Glasgow's Officer Training Corps, where he joins students for drill. The political pundit then heads west along the Firth of Clyde to Helensburgh, where he discovers a pioneering group of artists known as the Glasgow Boys. The idyllic West Highland Line takes Michael deep into the Highlands to Inveraray and the ancestral home of the Clan Campbell and Dukes of Argyll. Michael's final stop is Connel Ferry, near Oban, where, on the Achnacloich Estate, he discovers a Highland calf whose breed has become an icon of the Highlands

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off on the first leg of a journey from the Midlands to Rye in East Sussex. At Cowley, he marvels at an automated state-of-the-art production line that produces 1,000 Minis a day. Michael probes the pre-First World War origins of the Morris Oxford and is delighted to find that cars for export are loaded in Italian Job style on to trains at the factory's own railhead

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo picks up his rail journey from Warwick to Rye. In Reading, he traces the origins of education for workers and in Henley-on-Thames he slips into a launch to hear about the world-famous regatta. Afternoon tea on the bank offers a chance for Michael to hear about four heroes of early 20th-century literary classic The Wind in the Willows

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the port of Monterey, he discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage, before heading to Paso de Robles, where he tours Hearst Castle, dream home of the newspaper baron, William Randolph Hearst. In the hills of Morro Bay, Michael joins avocado farmer, Jim Shanley, amid his 4,000 avocado trees to harvest the pears and learn how to make guacamole. Arriving in Los Angeles, Michael heads for the Warner Brothers studio, founded on Sunset Boulevard

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his tour of Los Angeles, joining the locals for Mexican Independence Day, and discovering the secrets of backyard oil drilling in a county that is home to the largest urban oil field in the US. programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, learning how surgery was first made bearable in 1846 by a miraculous new substance. programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: In Montreal, Michael Portillo discovers how French and British colonial roots have influenced the city's construction, cuisine and culture. programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef visits Palermo in northern Sicily, a city echoing Arab, North African, French, Spanish and Italian influences, making its cuisine unique and irresistible. Pine nuts, raisins, almonds and golden breadcrumbs are combined with flavours of sun-ripened tomatoes, lemons and the finest olive oil to create a range of unforgettable dishes. Rick witnesses locals celebrating a festival in honour of Palermo's patron saint Rosalia, and receives a cookery lesson from a real-life duchess. At home he cooks Marsala chicken, a Sicilian classic served in UK bistros since the 1960s

programme.title: Hell or High Water
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Foster, Chris Pine and Jeff Bridges. Toby and his loose-cannon brother Tanner put aside their differences to carry out a series of robberies. They target branches of the Texas Midlands Bank, an institution that is threatening to foreclose on their family farm. However, the predictable nature of the thefts allows a veteran ranger to second-guess their moves.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Through interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah looks at the international quantum arms race between the US and China

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Humanity's water supplies are shrinking amid climate change, population growth and poor management. Scarcity is displacing millions and could fuel conflicts. Hannah travels to Kenya to witness the crisis, and explores technologies offering ways to protect supplies and meet demand

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: It's the first quarter-final, and the four chefs who have fought their way through the heats return to the kitchen with everything to play for. First up, the chefs face the invention test in which they must make a dish starring a surprise ingredient - coconut. The cooks must then serve a two-course meal for two of the country's most discerning food critics, William Sitwell and Xanthe Clay, alongside chef and writer Rahel Stephanie

programme.title: John Simpson - Sixty Years at the BBC
programme.desc: John Simpson takes a look back at his 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global news stories of the era. He reflects on the changing world he has witnessed, including the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, and the fall of the Berlin Wall. John also reminisces on memorable encounters with inspiring leaders and cruel dictators

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers and Simon Bower test their driving skills with a 1950s racing game, a collection of shining retro pieces go up for sale, and the dealers are intrigued by a curious Victorian contraption

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A developer wants to add an extra floor onto a three-story building in East Sussex and a mum of four tackles a project in Dorset with help from the family. A property in Derbyshire shows some serious cracks

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul head to Shetland to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful archipelago for trout and pollock. The archipelago of about 100 islands off the north-east coast of Scotland is the furthest place in the UK they have travelled to fish, and it is wild and full of surprises for both of them

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI have allowed scientists to not only decode complex animal sound data, but also begin communicating with animals. Hannah meets a 'talking dog' in California and deciphers elephant rumbles in Nairobi. She also looks into the question of whether the emerging ability to communicate with animals is one that should be exploited

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: The journalist in conversation with people who influence our political thinking about what has shaped theirs

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted
programme.desc: Calum Clunie shares some of his secrets in a programme following him throughout a season of growing everything from onions to dahlias, culminating in his own show in his grandparents' back garden

programme.title: Angels One Five
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Jack Hawkins and Michael Denison. Summer 1940: a squadron of Hurricanes heads towards the Channel for a confrontation with German aircraft, while ground staff at the fighter station wait anxiously below.

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The experts set out their stalls in Manderston, near Berwick-on-Tweed. Items presented for the experts' attention include objects from Queen Victoria's household, a vicious-looking mantrap and a collection of rare biscuit tins worth several thousand pounds. Presented by Michael Aspel. Originally shown in 2005

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin hosts from Rochester Cathedral in Kent, where antiques expert Elizabeth Talbot falls for a book of fairy tales illustrated by Arthur Rackham, and Adam Partridge discovers an elegant chiming Swiss pocket watch. Paul also meets one of the last remaining survivors of the Dunkirk evacuation during the Second World War

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson take part in the final round of challenges on Double Points Friday. Michael Sheen asks the questions

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is on hand with more Strictly exclusives as she's joined by a new all-star panel to break down the couple's next dances

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: Live International Football
programme.desc: Scotland v North Macedonia (Kick-off 7.45pm). All the action from both teams' fifth and penultimate UEFA Nations League Group B1 match, held at Hampden Park. Scotland claimed a 2-0 win when these sides met last month in Skopje, thanks to Kieron Bowie's first goal for his country and a John McGinn penalty. Sébastien Pocognoli's men will now expect to claim their first home victory of the campaign against a side who have lost all four of their matches in the group

programme.title: Die Hard with a Vengeance
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Bruce Willis, Jeremy Irons and Samuel L Jackson. Following a terrorist explosion in a New York department store, suspended police officer John McClane and Harlem shopkeeper Zeus Carver become unwitting players in a deadly game of "Simon Says".

programme.title: AI: Probably Nothing To Worry About
programme.desc: The fullest account yet of AI's origins, told by the people who built it. Exclusive interviews and archival footage put pioneers Geoffrey Hinton and Demis Hassabis on the record, alongside former OpenAI staff. Hinton quit Google, fearing the technology he helped create. A Microsoft chatbot threatens its users. AI systems learn to deceive the people testing them. Not just a tech history lesson but an anarchic thriller, this is the story of a technology whose power sits not in the algorithms, but with the handful of people who control them

programme.title: Pierre
programme.desc: After Pierre's sudden collapse, he's discharged from hospital under strict instructions to avoid stress. But when he receives an anonymous tip-off, he can't resist the chance to discover what really happened to Michael

programme.title: Pierre
programme.desc: Jimmy Vale ups his campaign to strike fear into Pierre, Ronnie has some explaining to do, and Miriam faces criminal charges, with only Danny in her corner

programme.title: The Rhythm Section
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Blake Lively and Jude Law. Three years after her family died in a plane crash, Stephanie learns that it may have been a terrorist attack. Determined to exact revenge, she finds someone who can train her to be a killer.

programme.title: Unreported World: South Africa's Whistleblower Hitmen
programme.desc: Darshna Soni reports from Johannesburg on the business of contract killers who are used to silence whistleblowers. South Africa has a thriving marketplace of hitmen, with killings commissioned through middlemen and carried out for relatively small sums. Once the preserve of gangland turf wars, a hitman's services are now used to settle scores across the country, with 141 targeted killings in 2022 alone

programme.title: Sunday Brunch
programme.desc: Highlights of the food and chat show, with Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
programme.desc: Kirstie and Phil help Sue and Richard from Mapperley decide whether to sell or renovate their home. After Richard suffered a stroke two years ago he struggles to get around the two-storey house and thinks one-level living would be much easier for them, but Sue loves their home and thinks with a complete re-jig of the ground floor they could make it fit their needs. While Kirstie conjures up a plan to make their home more accessible, Phil sets out to find a one-floor home for them with some gorgeous views

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Norm agrees to paint Rebecca's office in return for running up his tab.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Cliff puts up a fight to save his family home from developers, who plan to build a convenience store in its place. Comedy, starring John Ratzenberger

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug tries to get out of going to the bank with Carrie, claiming he is too busy at work, but a stapler-inflicted injury in a delicate area makes him see the error of his ways. Comedy, starring Kevin James

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Deacon and Kelly ask Doug and Carrie to be godparents to their newborn son. Comedy, starring Kevin James, Leah Remini and Victor Williams

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray's advice comes back to haunt him when he is blamed for the break-up of Robert's relationship with Amy

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Marie discovers she and Frank are not as fit as they thought, so she throws out all their junk food and persuades him to join her on a diet. However, this goes down badly with the rest of the family. Comedy, starring Peter Boyle and Doris Roberts
