programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: Struggling to cope with his alter ego Venom, Eddie Brock attempts to re-ignite his journalistic career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady. However, Kasady becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution. Comic-book fantasy sequel, directed by Andy Serkis and starring Tom Hardy, Woody Harrelson and Michelle Williams

programme.title: For Those in Peril
programme.desc: Drama starring George MacKay. A young man called Aaron is the only survivor of a mysterious fishing accident that claimed the lives of five others, including his older brother. Shunned by the local community, Aaron retreats into himself and begins to believe that he may have the power to bring his brother back.

programme.title: Gunman's Walk
programme.desc: Western starring Van Heflin and Tab Hunter. Growing up in the shadow of former gunslinger Lee Hackett is a tough proposition for his sons Ed and Davy. While Davy looks for love, Ed's explosive temperament threatens to destroy everything his father has built.

programme.title: Arizona Raiders
programme.desc: Western starring Audie Murphy and Michael Dante. Two captured Confederates are promised freedom if they join the Union's Arizona Raiders in a bid to destroy their old guerrilla group.

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: Warlock
programme.desc: Western drama starring Richard Widmark, Henry Fonda and Anthony Quinn. When the townspeople of Warlock decide to take a stand against a group of hellraising cowboys, they find their choice of an ageing marshal brings its own problems.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Bill Paxton, Helen Hunt and Cary Elwes. When one of the planet's most deadly natural phenomena blows into town, a feuding team of professional tornado-chasing meteorologists tracks the trail of destruction.

programme.title: Predator
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. A rescue mission deep in the Central American jungle turns into a fight for survival as a crack commando unit, led by Major "Dutch" Schaeffer, comes up against an unseen enemy - a predator able to resist the most up-to-date weaponry and kill with relentless efficiency.

programme.title: Boss Level
programme.desc: Former Special Forces operative Roy Pulver wakes every day in his apartment with a beautiful woman in his bed and assassins trying to kill him. Stuck in a time loop, Roy must dodge bullets and blade attacks to unlock the mystery behind his repetitive and untimely demise. Action comedy, starring Frank Grillo

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: Struggling to cope with his alter ego Venom, Eddie Brock attempts to re-ignite his journalistic career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady. However, Kasady becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution. Comic-book fantasy sequel, directed by Andy Serkis and starring Tom Hardy, Woody Harrelson and Michelle Williams

programme.title: For Those in Peril
programme.desc: Drama starring George MacKay. A young man called Aaron is the only survivor of a mysterious fishing accident that claimed the lives of five others, including his older brother. Shunned by the local community, Aaron retreats into himself and begins to believe that he may have the power to bring his brother back.

programme.title: Gunman's Walk
programme.desc: Western starring Van Heflin and Tab Hunter. Growing up in the shadow of former gunslinger Lee Hackett is a tough proposition for his sons Ed and Davy. While Davy looks for love, Ed's explosive temperament threatens to destroy everything his father has built.

programme.title: Arizona Raiders
programme.desc: Western starring Audie Murphy and Michael Dante. Two captured Confederates are promised freedom if they join the Union's Arizona Raiders in a bid to destroy their old guerrilla group.

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: Warlock
programme.desc: Western drama starring Richard Widmark, Henry Fonda and Anthony Quinn. When the townspeople of Warlock decide to take a stand against a group of hellraising cowboys, they find their choice of an ageing marshal brings its own problems.

programme.title: Twister

programme.title: Medieval Murder Mysteries

programme.desc: The presenter dives deeper into Egypt's mysteries, exploring the Great Sphinx and the underground Serapeum with its precision-cut granite sarcophagi, questioning their purpose and links to the pyramid enigma. programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Jamaica, the Caribbean capital of the Empire, heading to Fort Charles where the Empire enlisted the help of pirates to defend the new territory from the Spanish. The island needed a new source of wealth, and found it in the triangular trade as slaves were shipped from Africa to work sugar plantations. programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels to South Africa to explore how the lure of riches led Britain into barbaric wars, dividing the country along racial lines. He visits the crumbling Fort Napier, the British garrison in Natal, where battles were planned and executed against the Zulu people. The white minority devised rules to subdue the native black population, corralling people into squalid townships and offering them menial jobs. Eventual conflict with the descendants of Dutch settlers - Boers - was inevitable. Michael learns how Mohandas Gandhi fought the racial segregation that would later calcify into Apartheid

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels to South Africa to explore how the lure of riches led Britain into barbaric wars, dividing the country along racial lines. He visits the crumbling Fort Napier, the British garrison in Natal, where battles were planned and executed against the Zulu people. The white minority devised rules to subdue the native black population, corralling people into squalid townships and offering them menial jobs. Eventual conflict with the descendants of Dutch settlers - Boers - was inevitable. Michael learns how Mohandas Gandhi fought the racial segregation that would later calcify into Apartheid

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo tells the story of how a small island on the edge of Europe built the biggest empire the world has ever seen. In the first episode, Michael travels to India to uncover how the British East India Company - the world's first multinational corporation - raised a private army to create an empire. Beginning his journey in the slums of Kolkata, he explores the ruins of the grand residence of Clive of India, who became the undisputed ruler of Bengal - amassing a vast personal fortune and making millions for shareholders in Britain

programme.title: Portillo's Empire Journey
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Jamaica, the Caribbean capital of the Empire, heading to Fort Charles where the Empire enlisted the help of pirates to defend the new territory from the Spanish. At the old naval headquarters, Michael learns how the Royal Navy moved in to replace the pirates as Britain struck a deal with Spain to keep her territories. The island needed a new source of wealth, and found it in the triangular trade as slaves were shipped from Africa to work sugar plantations. In Pinnacle, birthplace of the Rastafari movement, Michael learns how Jamaicans were later inspired to create a new religion

programme.title: DIY SOS Strictly Special
programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing stars Anton Du Beke, Katya Jones and Graziano Di Prima join Nick Knowles and the team in Wallsend, Newcastle. Together, they set to work transforming the True Colours performing arts school, an inclusive dance school that teaches dance and theatre skills to 500 children and young adults weekly, many of whom have disabilities and learning needs. The school has grown substantially over time and they've completely outgrown their existing space, so the team get to work renovating a run-down old boys' club that would give the dance school the extra space it so desperately needs to continue to transform more young lives

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles and the team descend on Caswell Bay, Swansea, to transform a dilapidated, out-of-use bus shelter a fully adapted centre for Surfability UK, a charity that provides surfing lessons and experiences for people with disabilities and learning difficulties. programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles helps adapt a house in Enfield, north London, for Eric Rivers, who is terminally ill with motor neurone disease. programme.title: Blue Story
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Stephen Odubola and Micheal Ward. Timmy, a smart but shy kid from Deptford, goes to a school in Peckham where he meets streetwise local boy Marco. programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: Desperate to recover their losses, the Phelans strike a deal with Ozzie Thompson. At Jamie and Melissa's engagement party, Michael and Diana attempt to broker peace with the family. Meanwhile, Freddie spirals further out of Michael's control

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Hollywood star Bill Murray travels around the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland, combining golf with a search for his Irish roots. In Kinsale, Co Cork, chance encounters turn a simple walk into an adventure, while Bill's golf writer friend Tom Coyne tries to keep things on track

programme.title: Fire and Floods: Our Extreme Weather
programme.desc: How 2026 has seen a rise in unusual weather conditions in the UK, including one of the wettest winters on record, an exceptional dry spell, and a series of record-busting heatwaves. With extremes happening more frequently, and at unprecedented times, across all our seasons. Impacts of climate change are no longer a future prospect for future generations. The country is facing them now, with every area of life affected

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Brinicle invites Pancake onto his radio show but is cross when his accidental burps prove a hit. Pancake soon discovers that fame as ‘burping guy’ has its downsides

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Dad and Cosima both think they're the best at pranking. Their prank war quickly spirals out of control, until Big Lizard finally reveals Proxima's real pranking champion!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: It's bathtime! The Ducklings are determined Weasy will get clean

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The Gnome Crystal Mine has ground to a halt, leaving the forest with no crystals, no power supply and melting ice lollies! The heroes are tasked with a quest to find out what has happened and to fix it. It turns out that a slimy beast named Smarg has made the mine her home. But with Hoofius's fear of gunk getting the better of him, evicting the slippery Smarg is not going to be easy.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings use magic Chinese lanterns for sound and light shows.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is a referee at a football match, and Frog sees how much a footballer is cheered for scoring a goal. He is desperate to score one himself, but can he get past Duck's red card?

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: Rising Hope
programme.desc: Liko worries that Hattrem could be holding itself back for the sake of others.

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: The dark magic of Vexius has contaminated Alfea with a lethal residue. The Winx, together with Flora's parents, are searching for a cure to save the flora and fauna of the magic kingdom.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: While trying to make new friends, Cammy accidentally starts a rumour. With Damien’s help, Layla rediscovers herself, and Melody tries to catch a cold that is circulating through the gym.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Current affairs reports aimed at a younger audience

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Shin and Abby take part in a Children in Need racing challenge

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve seeks out deadly creatures in miniature - including Australia’s most beautiful spider, Oman’s deadly deathstalker scorpion and a bright blue beauty in Indonesia.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don brings his globe-trotting botanical tour to a close with a visit to South-east Asia, where he hopes to witness a true tropical oasis. Visiting the immaculately presented garden of Jim Thompson House in Bangkok, he discovers an exotic plot with a Western flavour. He also meets former president Lee Kuan Yew, who once stated that Singapore should be 'a city in a garden'

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin explore why geese fly in a V formation, why leaves change colour in autumn and why birds eat rocks

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Anita strikes up an in-depth conversation with rock star Rod Stewart and his wife, broadcaster Penny Lancaster, discovering what makes Christmas special for them, and how it's been a marker for memorable moments in their careers, family life and faith

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain creates a selection of breakfasts ideal for the weekend, including granola and yoghurt cupcakes, a banana and peanut butter bake, and a breakfast pizza. She also meets 18-year-old Kitty Tait in Oxfordshire, who shares her ingenious recipe for z'atar honey and feta swirls. At just 14, Kitty started to suffer from debilitating anxiety, but with the help of her dad, discovered that the simple pleasure of baking bread transformed her mental health

programme.title: Ice Cold in Alex
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring John Mills, Sylvia Syms and Anthony Quayle. Libya 1942: an army officer with a drink problem leads a small party in an ambulance on a hazardous cross-desert journey to Alexandria.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Nottingham, a Victorian townhouse with an unusual back garden changes hands, a couple hope to transform a dilapidated mid-terrace in the Dorset town of Bournemouth, while a one-bed flat becomes an ultra-modern two-bed in north London. Martin Roberts, Tommy Walsh and Dion Dublin meet the people behind the renovations and monitor their progress

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and his team of experts invite members of the public to bring their antiques to be viewed and valued, with an option to sell at auction

programme.title: Match of the Day Wales Live
programme.desc: Norway v Wales (Kick-off 5.00pm). All the action from both teams' fifth and penultimate UEFA Nations League Group A4 match, held at Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo. Both teams have just one win and three defeats to their name in the group, with Wales' victory coming in last month's reverse fixture at Cardiff City Stadium. Oscar Bobb opened the scoring for the Norwegians on that occasion, but Craig Bellamy's men fought back with strikes from Dan James and Neco Williams

programme.title: Live International Football
programme.desc: Northern Ireland v Ukraine (Kick-off 7.45pm). All the action from both teams' penultimate UEFA Nations League Group B2 match, held at Windsor Park. Northern Ireland went into this round of fixtures on top of the table with two wins and two draws, with their most convincing display coming against the Ukrainians in Slovakia. They prevailed 3-0 in that contest thanks to a brace by Ciaron Brown and a strike from Isaac Price, and another victory would secure them a place in at least the promotion play-offs

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1975 at the BBC
programme.desc: Take a musical trip back in time to 50 years ago, with 40 essential hits from 1975 plucked from the BBC's archives. The punk explosion was two years away and disco was only just starting to surface, but these 12 months were still packed with classic songs that remain staples to this day. Key moments include Abba in Blackpool on Seaside Special and Bay City Rollers riding the wave of Rollermania, as well as debut hits from key artists who were pioneers in their individual genres, including Bob Marley, Supertramp and Kraftwerk

programme.title: Jon Richardson: Old Man Tour
programme.desc: A chance to see a live performance recorded at Blackpool's historic Grand Theatre, on what was the final night of the comedian's sell-out, 158-date UK and Ireland tour. Here, Jon takes to the stage to comment - and generally complain - on topics including parenthood, Brexit and haircuts. The question of why nobody but him can correctly load a dishwasher is also raised. Alas, Jon can offer no solutions to all the problems he identifies, but nevertheless provides plenty of mirth as he fails to reach a viable conclusion to his grouses

programme.title: This Is England
programme.desc: Drama set during the early 1980s, starring Thomas Turgoose and Stephen Graham. After losing his father in the Falklands War and being bullied at school, young Shaun Fields finds friendship with Woody and his gang of skinheads. But when an old friend of Woody's appears on the scene, the group's loyalties become divided.

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay travels across the United States in search of restaurants in dire need of renovation - and after analysing their situation, he has just 24 hours to bring them back from the brink of disaster. His first stop is the New York community of Congers, where he hopes to save family-run Italian restaurant Bella Gianna's. Gordon and his team work round the clock to clean the premises, remodel the interior and revamp the menu, while also teaching the staff to prepare new dishes and work together as an efficient unit. What will the customers think of the new-look restaurant?

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings
programme.desc: Jon Richardson, Judi Love and their guests look back at the highlights of another week in the tent, which saw the contestants tackling caramel-based recipes. They celebrate the standout moments and serve up their take on the episode's biggest talking points and best bakes

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Council manager Charlotte hosts the first dinner party in Llanelli, Carmarthenshire, where she hopes to impress electrician Steve, occupational nurse Christine, retired French teacher Meic, and teaching assistant Ainsley with an evening that features a former rugby choir as entertainment

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Electrician Steve hosts the second night of the competition in Llanelli, Carmarthenshire, and hopes that his menu of lasagne, vegetable soup and homemade wine will impress his guests and win him the £1,000 prize. As the evening goes on, Meic decides to bare all with a revelation that shocks Christine

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Occupational nurse Christine hosts the third dinner party in Llanelli, where she tries to impress her guests with a menu of family favourites and a performance by her number one rock band. Charlotte and Meic stumble across the host's messy office, and trouble brews when Ainsley tells Christine that she looks like one of her exes

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Retired French teacher Meic hosts the fourth night of the competition in Llanelli, Carmarthenshire, and plans an authentic French menu including poulet Basquaise. Fellow diner Charlotte makes an impression when she arrives wearing an onion necklace, and the host hopes that his specially branded cremes brulees will impress his guests

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: It is the final day of the competition in Llanelli, and the turn of teaching assistant Ainsley to host. She wants to educate her guests, while serving an authentic Russian-themed dinner party. However, vodka-infused pavlova and some dancing may not be enough to offset the cantankerous mood at the dinner table

programme.title: Devon and Cornwall
programme.desc: The head gardener at Cornwall's Lost Gardens of Heligan sows the seeds of a wildflower revolution from a colourful crop of meadow flowers to help the rest of the county bloom. A trawler skipper live-streams his latest catch via Facebook to his customers, before selling direct to them off his boat when he returns to harbour. An engineer gets a replica of iconic locomotive the Puffing Devil back up to full steam, and a Devon wildlife ranger takes care of wild beavers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam is put forward as the star prize at a benefit auction held at the bar and soon finds himself in Lilith's hands, who has every intention of getting her money's worth. Comedy, starring Ted Danson and Bebe Neuwirth

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasier and Lilith go on holiday, while Woody begins dating an elderly woman who finds him irresistible, but only as long as he dresses as celebrated author Mark Twain. American comedy, starring Woody Harrelson and Kelsey Grammer

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca makes a pass at her boss in a moment of weakness and has to rely on Sam to help her out of an embarrassing predicament. American bar-room comedy, starring Kirstie Alley

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca starts smoking again, while Cliff helps his girlfriend Sally improve her image and brings her along to Cheers, where she inevitably catches Sam's roving eye. Bar-room comedy, starring Ted Danson and John Ratzenberger

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray keeps visiting Robert's new apartment, which always seems to be swarming with pretty girls - until Debra puts in an appearance and curtails his enthusiasm. Ray Romano stars

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: The spirit of Christmas is in short supply when Ray gives his parents a personalised toaster and they sneak off to exchange it for a coffee machine. American comedy, starring Ray Romano, Peter Boyle and Doris Roberts

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray is shocked to discover his father let him win a game of table tennis when he was 12, and indignantly demands a rematch, determined to secure a legitimate victory this time. American comedy, starring Ray Romano, Peter Boyle and Patricia Heaton

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Part one of two. A bout of crippling back pain prompts Frasier to begin taking strong medication - which dulls his senses and causes him to accidentally blurt out a long-held secret to Daphne. Comedy, with Kelsey Grammer and Jane Leeves

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Part two of two. Niles clashes with girlfriend Mel over a misunderstanding, Daphne picks up the wrong signals, and friends are thin on the ground at Frasier's Christmas party. Comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: The Cranes take a trip in the Winnebago on New Year's Eve to celebrate the turn of the new millennium, but a case of mistaken identity leaves Frasier and Martin trying to rescue Niles from another family's van

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Jazz musician Bleeding Gums Murphy teaches Lisa how to express her gloomy moods through music, and inspires her to write a blues tune for him - which proves unexpectedly popular

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart tries to impress his tough new friends by decapitating a statue of the town's founder Jebediah Springfield, but his act of vandalism only succeeds in turning everybody against him

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer takes Marge for granted once too often, driving her into the arms of a smooth-talking Lothario who charms her at the local bowling alley. Animated comedy, with the guest voice of Albert Brooks

programme.title: Evolution

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The competition kicks off in Dorset, where creased bedding and unwrapped biscuits prove problematic at Philip and Jimmy's 17th-century country inn

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Despite some excellent first impressions at a Surrey glampsite, the great outdoors soon leave one pair longing for the great indoors

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: In Dorset, a former Mayfair chef's eggstensive culinary eggsperience has everyone eggspecting an eggsceptional breakfast. But then one guest sends back his eggs.

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Including sport and weather

programme.title: Ottoman Empire by Train with Alice Roberts
programme.desc: Entering the Balkans by sleeper train, Alice makes her way through four countries as she follows in the footsteps of the Ottoman march across Europe. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team refresh and preserve three prized keepsakes, sparking fond memories of loved ones.
The day's first restoration falls to music box maestro Steve Kember. Marie Ayears arrives with a musical Grenadier Guard doll. Marie's dad served with the Grenadier Guards in the 1950s and was on duty in Westminster Abbey for Queen Elizabeth's coronation in 1953. The music box was bought by Marie's proud grandmother to mark the occasion. It is supposed to play the tune Auld Lang Syne, but Marie fears she may have overwound him, and now the mechanism is jammed. While Steve attempts to repair the music box, toy restorers Julie Tatchell and Amanda Middleditch must try and get his tired-looking unform fit for inspection.
Alice Ellingham and her mum June are next to arrive at the barn. They've brought in a sextant, used for navigation at sea by June's late husband Bob. Bob joined the Merchant Navy aged 16 and retired as captain of a cruise ship. The sextant was with him throughout his career and would have been a vital navigational tool in the days before GPS. Alice and June are both enormously proud of Bob's career and are hopeful Steve Fletcher can restore the instrument back to its pristine best so they can learn to use it as a way of connecting with Bob's past.
The day's final visitor is Rohan Gunatillake from Glasgow. He's the custodian of an unusual-looking chest that came from his grandmother's house in Sri Lanka and now serves as a connection to Rohan's Sri Lankan heritage. Rohan's grandmother lived in rural Sri Lanka on a farm surrounded by rubber trees, paddy fields and water buffalo. For Rohan, summer trips to see her were like visiting another world and made a lasting impression. Over time, sections of the chest have broken off, presenting a big challenge for furniture restorer Will Kirk. The chest is also missing a brass handle and casting a new one falls to silversmith Brenton West.

Unable to break through Nazi lines, troops were stalled in the mountains below Rome during the long winter months and into the spring. Elsewhere too, the invasion was going badly, as the landing at Anzio ended in failure with thousands of soldiers exposed to enemy fire and penned in by German forces

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Inhabitants of four American towns in Alabama, California, Connecticut and Minnesota recall the events of D-Day, in which more than 150,000 men landed on French soil to take part in the bloodiest conflict in US history since the Civil War

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: The Allies make slow progress through Europe during the summer of 1944, finding themselves bogged down in the Normandy countryside. In the Pacific, American forces on the island of Saipan fight their costliest battle to date, but the mood is buoyed by the eventual Nazi retreat and the liberation of Paris on August 25, ending four years of occupation

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: The plan to end the war in Europe by winter 1944 founders as Allied forces massed on the German border find themselves perilously short of fuel, leading commanders to take a risky gamble and parachute thousands of additional troops behind enemy lines. In the Pacific, General MacArthur heads one of the most brutal campaigns of the conflict while taking the island of Peleliu

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Examining General MacArthur's campaign to liberate the Philippines and his resultant popularity back home in America - which belied the scale of the bloodshed necessary for victory. The documentary also studies the US Army's losses in late autumn 1944, while trying to force its way through the heavily defended Hurtgen Forest and Vosges Mountains, which lie on Germany's eastern border

programme.title: Inside the Mind of Agatha Christie
programme.desc: Exploring the secrets of the author's enduring success and how her works have endured in the bestseller lists for nearly a century. Famous faces and die-hard fans delve deep into the literary archives to investigate what Christie's letters, notebooks and autobiography can tell us about the inner workings of her mind, and uncover the disparity between what people think they know about Christie and who she really was

programme.title: Eons: Life and Death on Pangea
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the most catastrophic mass extinction in our planet's history, beginning in the late Carboniferous Period. Predatory amphibians and giant arthropods ruled the swamps, but ancient seed plants and amniotes were evolving adaptations to drier climates. These help them thrive on Pangea in the Permian Period

programme.title: Eons: Life and Death on Pangea
programme.desc: The first herbivorous vertebrates evolved on the side of the amniote family tree, leading to mammals. Alongside them come apex predators, like Dimetrodon, but the Early Permian Period ends in a mystery. Is it an extinction or a fossil gap?

programme.title: Eons: Life and Death on Pangea
programme.desc: How life in the middle Permian Period flourished, including reef complexes which stretched for hundreds of kilometres in what is now the Texas desert

programme.title: Eons: Life and Death on Pangea
programme.desc: How mammal-like traits emerged in ancient creatures during the late Permian Period, and the dawn of the cynodonts, all before the time of the dinosaurs

programme.title: Eons: Life and Death on Pangea
programme.desc: How the Permian Period ended with the biggest mass extinction of all time. More than 80 per cent of species vanished, altering the course of evolution

programme.title: Eons: Life and Death on Pangea
programme.desc: Around 250 million years ago, at the dawn of the Triassic Period, life on Earth was devastated. Eventually, the survivors of the Permian were replaced by new ecosystems. The age of reptiles was beginning

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc:
In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero.
Since 2020, Manchester Town Hall has been undergoing the biggest heritage renovation project in the UK, at a cost of £325 million. Now, Repair Shop horologist Steve Fletcher has been invited to lend a hand getting its huge clock back up and running. So how will he fare on this super-sized fix?
Will is in nearby Oldham to pick up a vintage fruit machine that's close to John's heart. Inherited by him after a tragic accident, the mechanism is jammed, the paint scuffed, and he's never seen the lights working. Decades of experience mean game machine expert 'Pinball' Geoff is the perfect man for the job, but it will be a painstaking process getting it to pay out again.
Then we travel from the 1970s back to the 17th century as Will gets a crash course in traditional globe-making from man of many talents Jonathan Wright. Blending cartography, carpentry and several other heritage skills, he both restores antique examples and creates brand new globes on commission, making him the perfect teacher to show Will what goes into this delicate work.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Documentary about Police Scotland's Highlands and Islands division, revealing what it takes to patrol and keep the peace in one of the most beautiful and challenging places in Britain

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: Evelyn Hollow and Xara Gladman investigates the mystery of Morag, a monster said to lurk beneath teh waters of Loch Morar in the Highlands. They meet locals whose accounts have kept the story alive for generations, with a loch superintendent recalling a strange wake racing across the water and an angler describing three huge humps rising behind his boat

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: For more than half a century, stories of a mysterious figure known as the Catman have circulated through Greenock. With each retelling, the dividing line between eyewitness testimony, childhood rumour and urban myth has become harder to identify. Now, Evelyn Hollow and Zara Gladman are on a mission to discover who the Catman really is, examining whether it is a real person or a character created and sustained by generations of storytellers

programme.desc: Best-selling author and ex-gang member Graeme Armstrong travels to forgotten areas of Scotland to shine a light on the allure of gang life. programme.title: Despicable Me 2

Having already acquired a wife and three orphan daughters, reformed supervillain Gru now discovers that he has a long-lost twin, Dru. But Dru is hoping he can convince his brother to return to his wicked ways...

Twenty-six years later, two children discover the game and unwittingly unleash its dangerous magic. They also release Alan, now an adult, who realises that to escape the game they must play it to the end.

Four high-school students discover a dusty 1990s video game and are sucked into its world as the characters they chose. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and featuring William Shatner. When an evil alien threatens to destroy a star system along with millions of lives, Captain Jean-Luc Picard travels into a time vortex to enlist the help of his famous predecessor, James T Kirk.

When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: The African Queen

East Africa, 1914: when her home is destroyed by invading Germans, a prim missionary finds an unlikely saviour in the scruffy, gin-drinking captain of a small steam-driven riverboat, The African Queen. Together, the indomitable pair begin a treacherous journey downriver to conduct their own private battle against the enemy.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring José Ferrer and Colette Marchand. As a child, Toulouse-Lautrec suffered an accident that stopped his legs from growing, but he was destined to become famous as the painter whose work brought to life the Montmartre area of Paris.

As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
programme.desc: Profit-hungry pharmaceutical representative Martin Krebs contracts covert operations specialist Zora Bennett to assemble a crack team to infiltrate a forbidden island and collect the DNA of three key dinosaur species. Fantasy adventure, starring Scarlett Johansson, Mahershala Ali and Jonathan Bailey

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker. Disgraced cop Brian O'Conner is given the chance to redeem himself by going under cover to entrap a powerful Miami drugs baron.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
programme.desc: Profit-hungry pharmaceutical representative Martin Krebs contracts covert operations specialist Zora Bennett to assemble a crack team to infiltrate a forbidden island and collect the DNA of three key dinosaur species. Fantasy adventure, starring Scarlett Johansson, Mahershala Ali and Jonathan Bailey

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: One of Them Days
programme.desc: When best friends and roommates Dreux and Alyssa discover the latter's boyfriend has blown their rent money, the duo faces a race against time to avoid eviction. Comedy, starring Keke Palmer and SZA

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Central Intelligence
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Dwayne Johnson and Kevin Hart. Life gets dangerous for bored accountant Calvin Joyner when he reconnects with a former school classmate who now works in international espionage.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Singin' in the Rain
programme.desc: Classic musical comedy starring Gene Kelly, Debbie Reynolds and Donald O'Connor. Silent film stars Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont are the golden couple of 1920s Hollywood. However, when "talkies" become all the rage, prima donna Lina is shown up by the new technology and aspiring actress Kathy Selden is called in to dub her voice.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: Caught Stealing
programme.desc: Former baseball player Henry 'Hank' Thompson foolishly agrees to cat-sit for British neighbour Russ, and walks unwittingly into the middle of a turf war between warring factions. Director Darren Aronofsky's comedy thriller, starring Austin Butler, Zoe Kravitz and Matt Smith

programme.title: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Al Pacino, John Cazale and Charles Durning. On a hot August day in 1972, Sonny Wortzik and two accomplices enter a Brooklyn bank and hold the staff at gunpoint. But the robbery goes wrong and when police surround the building, Sonny and his morose friend Sal become trapped inside with their hostages.

programme.title: Hungry
programme.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Ouija
programme.desc: Horror starring Olivia Cooke. After the mysterious suicide of her best friend, a young woman uses a Ouija board to find out what led to her death. She recruits some friends to help her make contact, but it's not long before dark and deadly forces are unleashed.

programme.title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
programme.desc: Horror thriller prequel starring Elizabeth Reaser. Fake fortune teller Alice purchases a Ouija board for her act, only to find it works a little too well.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: Black comedy action horror starring Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino and Juliette Lewis. Fleeing the law, two murderous brothers kidnap a priest and his family, driving the priest's Winnebago south for a rendezvous at a lowlife bar in Mexico. Little do they know that the bar's staff and regulars hide a blood-drenched secret.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from the director of The Shape of Water, starring Charlie Hunnam and Idris Elba. In an epic war between colossal monsters from under the sea and gigantic human-controlled robots, it's up to two unlikely heroes to save mankind.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: Sci-fi action drama starring Sharlto Copley. Nearly thirty years after aliens landed near Johannesburg, the extraterrestrial visitors are living in a squalid refugee camp called District 9. With the initial welcoming attitude of the human population long since faded, the order is given for the space visitors to be forcibly evicted. For one man, the operation will be a life-changing experience.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East. When young Mormon missionaries Sister Barnes and Sister Paxton visit the house of potential convert Mr Reed, he engages them in religious debate. However, his interest in doctrine takes a menacing turn when he traps them in his house and begins to reveal far darker intentions.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring Harrison Ford and Ryan Gosling. Los Angeles blade runner Officer K uncovers a shocking secret that puts him on the trail of Rick Deckard, who has been missing for 30 years. Meanwhile, corporate magnate Niander Wallace seeks the truth about so-called replicant reproduction in order to further his plans for interstellar colonisation.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: Sci-fi action drama starring Sharlto Copley. Nearly thirty years after aliens landed near Johannesburg, the extraterrestrial visitors are living in a squalid refugee camp called District 9. With the initial welcoming attitude of the human population long since faded, the order is given for the space visitors to be forcibly evicted. For one man, the operation will be a life-changing experience.

programme.title: Heretic

When young Mormon missionaries Sister Barnes and Sister Paxton visit the house of potential convert Mr Reed, he engages them in religious debate. However, his interest in doctrine takes a menacing turn when he traps them in his house and begins to reveal far darker intentions.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy starring Bill Murray, Sigourney Weaver and Dan Aykroyd. Three university professors researching parapsychology set up in business for themselves when their grant is withdrawn, and soon realise there's a burgeoning market for "ghost busters" in New York City.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Black History Month
programme.desc: Celebrate Black history through the power of cinema with unforgettable performances and stories, from Dreamgirls to Sinners and the stars who brought them to life

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Nuremberg
programme.desc: A US Army psychiatrist is sent to assess high-ranking Nazi prisoners - most notably Hermann Göring - to decide if they're fit for trial. As the Nuremberg trials begin, he becomes enmeshed in a psychological and legal battle. Director James Vanderbilt's thriller, starring Russell Crowe, Rami Malek and Leo Woodall

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn and Chase Infiniti. Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Adventure drama starring Tom Hanks and Helen Hunt. Workaholic executive Chuck Noland is looking forward to spending Christmas with his girlfriend, but is sent abroad on an assignment at the last minute. When his plane crashes into the Pacific, Chuck is stranded alone on a remote, uninhabited island.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Boss Level
programme.desc: Former Special Forces operative Roy Pulver wakes every day in his apartment with a beautiful woman in his bed and assassins trying to kill him. Stuck in a time loop, Roy must dodge bullets and blade attacks to unlock the mystery behind his repetitive and untimely demise. Action comedy, starring Frank Grillo

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Sasha Luss, Luke Evans and Helen Mirren. A young Russian woman fleeing her abusive home is recruited to the KGB and trained as an assassin. Initially, Anna is told she will be employed for only five years and then allowed a comfy retirement, but she soon discovers her handlers have other plans and a deadly game of survival begins.

programme.title: Dora and the Lost City of Gold
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Isabela Moner. Sixteen-year-old Dora has grown up in the Peruvian rainforest with her zoologist mother and archaeologist father. When her parents head off on a dangerous mission to find a lost Incan city, Dora finds herself in uncharted territory: a Los Angeles high school - but arriving in this strange new world is just the beginning of a new adventure.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Comedy starring Beattie Edmondson. Teacher Sarah is gifted her grandmother's spoiled prize pug, Patrick. Though Sarah at first struggles to cope, she soon develops a bond with the pampered pooch and is eventually led towards success in her professional and personal lives.

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows
programme.desc: Melodrama starring Jane Wyman and Rock Hudson. Wealthy widow Cary Scott, after years of shunning company, falls in love with gardener Ron Kirby, who is 15 years her junior. The difference in social status as well as their age shocks her family and friends, and soon their relationship is affected by gossip.

programme.title: The Golden Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Phillip Law, Caroline Munro and Tom Baker. Sinbad acquires part of a magical golden amulet but when he sets sail to find the remainder, he comes up against the evil forces of the magician Koura.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Tessa Thompson and Chris Hemsworth. Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Sci-fi action prequel starring Amber Midthunder and Dane DiLiegro. Eighteenth-century Comanche healer Naru wishes to hunt and fight like the men in her tribe. When a mysterious entity that leaves strange tracks begins to attack the local wildlife, Naru has a chance to prove herself - but this predator is unlike anything on Earth...

programme.title: Cocaine Bear
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Keri Russell. A black bear stumbles across an abandoned stash of cocaine in a Tennessee forest. When it eats some of the drug, the bear is sent on a violent rampage, endangering various hikers, rangers and drug dealers, as well as nurse Sari - whose daughter has skipped school to spend a day in the woods.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Years after he fought his way out of a seemingly inescapable prison, Ray Breslin has organissed a top-notch security force. But when one of his team members goes missing, Breslin must return to the hell he once escaped from. Action thriller sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone and Dave Bautista

programme.title: The Young Americans
programme.desc: Stylish thriller, starring Harvey Keitel as a hard-bitten New York cop, assigned to Scotland Yard to help combat Europe's increasing drug problem, who has his own secret agenda for tracking down crime kingpin Viggo Mortensen. With Iain Glen, Craig Kelly and Keith Allen

programme.title: The Land That Time Forgot
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure directed by and starring C Thomas Howell. A yachting holiday turns into a mind-bending trip for two couples after a fierce storm leaves them stranded on an island inhabited by prehistoric beasts and the German crew of a U-boat from the Second World War.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: At the brink of an intimate moment, a seismic shift sends Marguerite and Roxton to the bottom of a pit. There, they discover that a pirate from a bygone era left behind his bones and his treasure. The booty instantly attracts Marguerite, and not even warnings of a curse deter her from taking the newly discovered fortune back to the treehouse.

programme.desc: A woman sees Earth falling out of orbit and into a blazing star. Lois Nettleton stars

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: An American Civil War soldier stumbles across a strange town full of enemy troops in suspended animation. Drama, starring Gary Merrill

programme.title: The Lost World

But when they enter the crevice, the path leads them to a blinding light and an entirely new corner of the Lost World. On the other side of the mountain lies a mysterious reflection of sunlight and an English-style town.

programme.desc: While exploring the jungle, some of the explorers encounter distressed strangers that bear a resemblance to Veronica and Malone. When the strangers' pursuers track them down, Veronica and Malone are taken captive by these mysterious entities with powerful weapons. At the order of their alien leader, Malone and Veronica are taken to a labor camp where they are forced to work for alien overlords.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: After the treehouse is raided by a monkey, Roxton and Marguerite track the culprit to a cave. There, they discover a strange amulet that marks them with a tattoo of a dinosaur skull. This imprint seems to provoke some primal instincts from the explorers as they morph into their more beast-like selves. Overcome by a power that science can't explain, the group begins to exhibit heightened senses.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: Marguerite and Challenger enter an ancient Temple laden with traps and mystical protections. After Marguerite falls into a pit of spikes, Challenger must leave her to get help. With her injuries come vivid hallucinations, and the carved warriors that guard the Temple come to life. These guardians attack the others when they arrive to rescue Marguerite.

programme.title: Match of the Day Wales Live
programme.desc: Norway v Wales (Kick-off 5.00pm). All the action from both teams' fifth and penultimate UEFA Nations League Group A4 match, held at Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo. Both teams have just one win and three defeats to their name in the group, with Wales' victory coming in last month's reverse fixture at Cardiff City Stadium. Oscar Bobb opened the scoring for the Norwegians on that occasion, but Craig Bellamy's men fought back with strikes from Dan James and Neco Williams

programme.title: Live International Football
programme.desc: Northern Ireland v Ukraine (Kick-off 7.45pm). All the action from both teams' penultimate UEFA Nations League Group B2 match, held at Windsor Park. Northern Ireland went into this round of fixtures on top of the table with two wins and two draws, with their most convincing display coming against the Ukrainians in Slovakia. They prevailed 3-0 in that contest thanks to a brace by Ciaron Brown and a strike from Isaac Price, and another victory would secure them a place in at least the promotion play-offs

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1975 at the BBC
programme.desc: Take a musical trip back in time to 50 years ago, with 40 essential hits from 1975 plucked from the BBC's archives. The punk explosion was two years away and disco was only just starting to surface, but these 12 months were still packed with classic songs that remain staples to this day. Key moments include Abba in Blackpool on Seaside Special and Bay City Rollers riding the wave of Rollermania, as well as debut hits from key artists who were pioneers in their individual genres, including Bob Marley, Supertramp and Kraftwerk

Deireadh an t-sreath, tha Liusaidh agus Màiri Anna a' dèanamh air Gall Ghàidhealaibh a thadhal air meantor Liusaidh, Mark Williams bho Wild Galloway. Tha iad shìos air na cladaichean san sgìre, a bhuain glasraich mara nach gabh a lorg air Ghàidhealtachd, agus a tha blasta dha-rìribh. Tha iad a' beachdachadh cuideachd air a bhi trusadh ann an dòigh a tha mothachail, cùramach. Tha iad an uairsin a' tilleadh dhachaigh a dheasachadh ròic do dh'aoighean a bhios a' tadhal orra. Tha Raonaid Walker agus Aaron Jones a' ruigheachd agus a' seinn òrain a tha gu math iomchaidh airson cuspair an t-sreath, agus tha preusantan aig Liusaidh is Màiri Anna dhaibh de bhiadh is deoch bhon t-sreath a dheasaicheadh bho an ceàrnaidhean fhèin.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke forage for nature's bounty. In the season finale, Lucy and Mary Ann head for Galloway to visit Lucy's foraging mentor, Mark Williams of Wild Galloway. They are down on the shore, foraging super-tasty sea vegetables that can't be found in the Highlands. They also consider foraging with an eye to sustainability and awareness of protected species. They then head for home to prepare a feast for guests. Musicians Rachel Walker and Aaron Jones arrive and perform a very appropriate song for the series, while Lucy and Mary Ann have edible gifts for them that originate in their own home turf.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team refresh and preserve three prized keepsakes, sparking fond memories of loved ones.
The day's first restoration falls to music box maestro Steve Kember. Marie Ayears arrives with a musical Grenadier Guard doll. Marie's dad served with the Grenadier Guards in the 1950s and was on duty in Westminster Abbey for Queen Elizabeth's coronation in 1953. The music box was bought by Marie's proud grandmother to mark the occasion. It is supposed to play the tune Auld Lang Syne, but Marie fears she may have overwound him, and now the mechanism is jammed. While Steve attempts to repair the music box, toy restorers Julie Tatchell and Amanda Middleditch must try and get his tired-looking unform fit for inspection.
Alice Ellingham and her mum June are next to arrive at the barn. They've brought in a sextant, used for navigation at sea by June's late husband Bob. Bob joined the Merchant Navy aged 16 and retired as captain of a cruise ship. The sextant was with him throughout his career and would have been a vital navigational tool in the days before GPS. Alice and June are both enormously proud of Bob's career and are hopeful Steve Fletcher can restore the instrument back to its pristine best so they can learn to use it as a way of connecting with Bob's past.
The day's final visitor is Rohan Gunatillake from Glasgow. He's the custodian of an unusual-looking chest that came from his grandmother's house in Sri Lanka and now serves as a connection to Rohan's Sri Lankan heritage. Rohan's grandmother lived in rural Sri Lanka on a farm surrounded by rubber trees, paddy fields and water buffalo. For Rohan, summer trips to see her were like visiting another world and made a lasting impression. Over time, sections of the chest have broken off, presenting a big challenge for furniture restorer Will Kirk. The chest is also missing a brass handle and casting a new one falls to silversmith Brenton West.

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: How animals in the polar regions adapt to the summer weather. In a colony of 400,000 king penguins the adults go surfing and the chicks take mud-baths to cool off, while polar bear cubs take their first swimming lessons as the ice they inhabit melts away. A minke whale is hunted by a family of killer whales, succumbing to their battering after two hours, and Adelie penguins try to prevent their chicks being snatched by skuas

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: With the arrival of autumn the Arctic Ocean begins freezing over, and polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast as they await the return of the ice. Two thousand beluga whales head for a particular estuary to thrash against the gravel and exfoliate, while in Antarctica, Adelie penguins take to the sea for the first time and face the danger of leopard seal attacks

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines how the arrival of winter sparks a ruthless battle for survival in the polar regions, with temperatures plummeting to -70C, winds reaching 120mph and day-long darkness. As a blizzard rages, a polar bear treks into the Arctic mountains to give birth, while the entire world population of spectacled eider braves the weather in a giant ice hole. Wolves and bison engage in battle, but alliances are also made, and beneath the snow, voles try to dodge the attacks of great grey owls and weasels

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the life and work of people in the polar regions, including the residents of Norilsk in Siberia, the coldest city on Earth. He also discovers how the Danish armed forces maintain their country's claim to Greenland's natural resources by mounting a 2,000-mile dog sled patrol during the winter, and finds out how a research base at the South Pole is able to cope with being cut off from the outside world for six months at a time

programme.title: Psychopath with Piers Morgan
programme.desc: In 2007, when Paris Bennett was 13 years old, stabbed his four-year-old sister to death, a crime for which he has been behind bars ever since. Now 25 and in his first interview on British television, he tells Piers Morgan how this was no impulsive fit of rage but rather a cold, deliberate act planned as an act of revenge against his mother Charity - who is watching the interview unfold in a nearby room. She has stood by him even though she fears that when he gets out, he could still harbour violent intentions towards her - or even worse, towards his younger brother

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part one of three. Yvonne is suspended from duty pending further investigation into the death of young thug Lee Thomas, and Leela is also accused of assaulting a suspect, leaving the relief uncertain as to what constitutes reasonable force when making an arrest. Fearful of leaving himself open to accusations of heavy-handedness or police brutality, Tony later hesitates to use force in a confrontation with local youths - and suffers a horrific beating. Meanwhile Zain Nadir agrees to do a stint in CID before beginning his next undercover job

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part two of three. As Tony recovers in hospital, Gabriel and Roger are disciplined for using their CS spray in a tense situation, prompting June to stand up for coppers' rights and call the demoralised relief out on strike. Unfortunately for Lance, he's already been dragged out on an unauthorised mission by Zain Nadir, and ends up being held at gunpoint by a local gangster. On the personal front, Phil receives the shocking news that Kate Maltby has been rushed to hospital and might lose their baby, while Dan receives a letter in the internal mail from someone who clearly knows about his affair with Sun Hill newcomer Rochelle Barratt

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part three of three. Adam tries to defuse the threat of strike action by the relief, reminding them of their duties as police officers and offering to let Yvonne return to the station while the inquiry takes its course. Dan reacts with dismay when Rochelle suggests they put their affair on hold, Gary chafes under Suzie's condescending attitude, and Samantha looks on in disbelief as the simmering hostility between brothers Phil and Steve erupts into violence

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part one of two. Laura looks at Gabriel with new eyes when he takes a surprisingly compassionate approach to her wayward son Liam, who is being bullied because of her job. Adam tries to mend fences with the rank-and-file officers by going out on the beat with June - only to lose his cool completely when a traffic accident triggers painful memories. Samantha jeopardises Jo's investigation by poaching her informant, leading to a bitter row, while Gary's future on the force looks uncertain after he reacts to Suzie's constant needling with a very public outburst

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part two of two. Laura begins to feel increasingly unfulfilled in her role as PCSO, and announces to Smithy that she wants to become a PC. Gina's old flame Jonathan Fox returns to Sun Hill, and Neil pressures Gary to drop his bullying accusations against Susie Sim. Gabriel warns an increasingly infatuated Sheelagh not to get involved with him, while Samantha continues to needle Jo, fuelling an already volatile situation

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Terry appears in court to testify against brother Ben, but reacts badly to being questioned about his own childhood abuse, indirectly jeopardising the outcome of the trial. programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: How animals in the polar regions adapt to the summer weather. In a colony of 400,000 king penguins the adults go surfing and the chicks take mud-baths to cool off, while polar bear cubs take their first swimming lessons as the ice they inhabit melts away. A minke whale is hunted by a family of killer whales, succumbing to their battering after two hours, and Adelie penguins try to prevent their chicks being snatched by skuas

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: With the arrival of autumn the Arctic Ocean begins freezing over, and polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast as they await the return of the ice. Two thousand beluga whales head for a particular estuary to thrash against the gravel and exfoliate, while in Antarctica, Adelie penguins take to the sea for the first time and face the danger of leopard seal attacks

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines how the arrival of winter sparks a ruthless battle for survival in the polar regions, with temperatures plummeting to -70C, winds reaching 120mph and day-long darkness. As a blizzard rages, a polar bear treks into the Arctic mountains to give birth, while the entire world population of spectacled eider braves the weather in a giant ice hole.
